sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You become the host your family returns to.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your home is where your family ends up, for meals and holidays and the nights someone needs a bed. Because a full house makes you feel settled, you take on more hosting than anyone asks of you. Relatives treat your door as always open, and you rarely show them how tired you are by the end.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: In your first home a sibling or a cousin stood beside you as an equal, and the two of you looked after each other. You learned to settle things between yourselves, and the adults were the last to hear about them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: Wherever you have lived so far, people have drifted to your kitchen for a meal or a night or a long weekend. You have fed more people than you could easily afford to, and you have counted it as time well spent.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Younger people look to you from your late forties for guidance, and for cover when things fall apart. You give both steadily in these years, and you see what you taught them carry on in their lives.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you organise their own lives around what you have arranged. You share more of your stories with them in these years, and they come to know you as well as they trust you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1993 to 2002
sections.text: Those years made you an equal in your family, with a voice as strong as anyone's. You stood on your own feet among your relatives, and they treated your word as worth the same as theirs.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: Family support reaches you in these ten years, as advice, practical help or a place to come back to. You receive more care than you expected, and you return it to the people who gave it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Obligations at home pile up in these years, with duties to the people who rely on you and a family name to protect. You meet them faithfully, and you guard a part of your life that belongs to you alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: Keeping the household in order weighs on you in these years, and you carry more of it than your share. The order you built keeps you going, and you pass some of the load over once your family sees it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Twin year
sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a Steward year
sections.text: Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Twin lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years you learned to rely on yourself. Your first home expected you to manage, and you were trusted with your own problems before most children are. Because you were trusted young, you came to trust yourself before anyone else, and you worked out much of what you know without asking. The habit makes it hard for you to let people in, at home or anywhere, and you accept help only after you have tried it alone.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life is built around comfort shared at home. You are happiest where food, rest and easy company are part of every day, and you choose a partner who enjoys them with you. Because ease makes you feel safe, you look after the people you live with through meals and small favours more than through words. Your relatives and friends end up at your table, and you give so much to the household that your own rest comes last.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Sage stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life you are seen as the one who teaches and protects. Because care and knowledge are what you have to give, you pass them on freely, to children or younger relatives or someone you train. Most of your growth in later life comes through teaching, and it sorts out your own thinking as much as anyone's. Your family treats you as the person to call when something goes wrong. You hear other people's troubles far more often than anyone asks after you, and you feel that on quiet evenings.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years rest on a quiet sense of duty done well. You want your affairs settled and your debts paid, and an unanswered letter stays on your mind until it is done. Because keeping your word is how you feel at peace, you finish what you owe before you allow yourself to rest. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, trust that your arrangements will hold. Your growth in later life comes from the few things you value, done a little better each year.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grow by moving from one structure to the next.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You grow inside a framework, a course or a firm or a discipline, until you have learned everything it can teach. Because loyalty runs deep in you, leaving one structure for a bigger one feels like a betrayal, and you wait longer than you need to. Your growth comes in clear stages, and each one starts when you finally move.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You taught yourself things as a child that the adults around you had not shown you, and you kept quiet about how hard it was. By the time you were grown you had a stubborn way of learning, on your own terms and at your own pace.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: You grew through formal steps from your late teens on, a qualification finished or a rank reached or a role handed to you. Each structure you joined shaped you for a few years, and you stayed in most of them a little past the point they could teach you.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have kept to what you already do well, and you have started fewer new things than in any years before.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: What you know takes a lasting form from your late forties, a course or a set of notes or a body of advice. You see it outlast your own part in it, and you take quiet pride in that.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: Past your late forties you keep improving at what you already know, and each year adds polish more than novelty. You grow wiser through repetition and care, and you end up with a character that others hold up as an example.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1993 to 2002
sections.text: Your progress in those years came from peers who were your equals, people you learned beside more than beneath. You set your own standard and met it, and the confidence lasted.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Unconventional paths taught you most in those years, a strange course, a self-taught skill or a mentor outside the usual. You developed in your own direction, and the difference became your strength.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: Setbacks arrive in these years without warning, and you are pushed before you feel ready. What carries you is the discipline you already have, and you end the decade tougher in ways that show later.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Private study and unusual interests change you this year in ways few people see, and you become more yourself out of public view.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: People rely on you to keep things steady.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are the one who keeps a group working, the colleague who remembers the deadline and the friend who makes the plan happen. Because order calms you, you take on the organising without being asked, and people come to depend on it. Your place in a circle is quiet, and you decide more than anyone credits you for.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Other children wanted to sit next to you, and the adults at family gatherings made a fuss of you. By your teens you were asked to more parties than you could go to, and you went to most of them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your friendships since your late teens have formed around strong reactions, people who liked your edge at once or never warmed to it. More than once a friendship ended over something you said in public, and you have kept every friend who stayed through it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your friendships have grown out of work and shared duties since your late teens, the colleagues you trusted and the seniors who trusted you. Friends you had no shared task with drifted further, and you kept the ones bound to you by a duty for years after the job ended.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Social seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties your evenings have gone to home and work more than to friends, and you have watched your circle thin without anyone deciding it.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Social seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1993 to 2002
sections.text: Friendships among equals defined those years, with people who matched your pace and asked nothing extra. You found a few friends who met you level, and you have kept some of them since.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2003 to 2012
sections.text: Those years filled your life with lively company, friends who competed with you and pushed you on. You were at your best among a crowd of equals, and you won their respect openly.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Duty shapes your friendships in these years, and social life feels more like obligation than pleasure. Your good name holds, and you find relief with the friends who expect nothing formal from you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: You meet more people in these years than you can keep up with, and old friends see less of you. A small group who knew you before this busy decade stays close, and you return to them again and again.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year over the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Artisan stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: warmth and easy charm were the first things people saw in you. Affection reached you early and without effort, from the older relatives around you and from children you had only just met. Because being liked came so easily, you expect a welcome wherever you go, and you usually get one. Your body has run well on regular meals and sleep, and you feel the cost of too many late nights later than your friends do.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work and among friends you are seen as gifted and hard to manage. Your talent is the first thing colleagues see, and your patience with rules is the last. Because you need your work to be judged fairly, you shine under bosses who reward results and stall under bosses who want obedience. Your friends are the people who enjoy your sharpest remarks, and you have lost a few who did not. You have walked away from at least one job that wanted you quieter.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years are built on duty done properly. You feel most yourself with a clear role and a job done properly, and you look for that in every place you join. Because steady reliability earns trust, your responsibilities grow year by year, and each new rank teaches you what the last one could not. Among friends you end up making the plans and keeping the dates, and you are relied on more than thanked.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your body does well when home is calm.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your health follows your home life closely, and you sleep and eat well in the seasons when the house is peaceful. Because tension at home reaches your body before you name it, a bad month with a partner shows up in your appetite and your rest. You recover fastest through ordinary comfort, a shared meal and an early night.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You ate well and slept soundly in your first years, and a bad day or a cold never kept you down for long. Food at home was a pleasure more than a rule, and by your teens you loved a good meal more than most of your friends did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: Your energy has risen and fallen so far with the state of your home, steady in the good years and low in the strained ones. Your sleep and appetite have followed each change at home, and they have settled again whenever the house grew calm.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: Support and good rest restore you in these ten years, and recovery from strain comes faster than before. You sleep well and eat well, and your energy holds steady through the decade.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: Pressure costs you sleep and energy through these years, and short nights add up faster than you notice. What carries you is sleep and slow meals given their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your career grows steadily inside a structure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You do your best work inside an organisation with fixed rules and a visible ladder, and you climb it by doing every step properly. Because you need to know where you stand, open-ended jobs leave you uneasy, and a proper title settles you. What you gain is lasting rank, and what you lose is the freedom to move quickly.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Bosses have either backed you fully or tried to slow you down since your late teens, and few have stayed neutral about you. You have done your best work for the ones who believed in you, and you have outlasted most of the ones who did not.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Each step up since your late teens has come after you proved you could do the last one properly, and you waited to feel ready before you asked for the next. Your seniors noticed your reliability early, and you were trusted with more than your age suggested.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Career seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties your private life has taken more of your energy than your career, and you have pushed for less at work than you could.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Career seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2003 to 2012
sections.text: Your work in those years was a contest, and you did best when someone else wanted the same result. You were sharpest with a rival close by, and that drive got you further than talent alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Unusual work suited you in those years, the kind that needs odd knowledge and long hours alone. You became good at something few others understood, and it earned you respect before it earned you anything else.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: Demands pile up in your work through these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing holds through the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: Routine tightens around your work in these years, and caution keeps you from moves that would pay more. Your reliability keeps you valued, and you find a better fit once someone else sees what you are worth.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Love in your chart. One sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You show love by making life easy.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You love by doing, the meal made and the evening kept free and the worry taken off someone's hands. Since giving comfort is how you feel close, you feel most loved by a partner who receives it gladly and gives some back. You give without keeping count, and you notice a partner who only takes much later than your friends do.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: The relationships that have lasted for you so far were the gentle ones, with partners who liked a quiet evening as much as you did. At least once you cooked and cared for someone who gave little back, and you stayed longer than the relationship deserved.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Love has no decade of its own. The pattern your Day Gate set is the one your love life keeps.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life is built around comfort shared at home. You are happiest where food, rest and easy company are part of every day, and you choose a partner who enjoys them with you. Because ease makes you feel safe, you look after the people you live with through meals and small favours more than through words. Your relatives and friends end up at your table, and you give so much to the household that your own rest comes last.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Mind in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your thinking stays quick because people keep asking.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You keep your mind in use by answering questions, reading widely and staying in touch with people who want your view. Because being consulted keeps you alert, you are sharpest in the weeks you are busiest with others. You feel slower in a week when nobody calls, and you pick up the phone yourself before the week is out.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also learn best when you can show what you learn, and you turn every course you finish into something you can say out loud.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Mind seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have used your mind for practical problems more than for ideas, and reading and study have had less of your week than they once did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Younger people bring you their hardest questions from your late forties, and you enjoy the work of answering them. You are quoted and asked for in these years, and you feel most yourself when a question has no easy answer.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Strange subjects drew you in those years, and you learned through instinct and odd sources more than set courses. Your thinking grew original, and you trusted hunches that later proved right.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: Learning comes easily in these years, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, and you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Sage year
sections.text: Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Odd, specialist subjects pull at your thinking this year, and you study alone what few people around you would think to ask about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against received ideas this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Sage stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life you are seen as the one who teaches and protects. Because care and knowledge are what you have to give, you pass them on freely, to children or younger relatives or someone you train. Most of your growth in later life comes through teaching, and it sorts out your own thinking as much as anyone's. Your family treats you as the person to call when something goes wrong. You hear other people's troubles far more often than anyone asks after you, and you feel that on quiet evenings.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: No seat rules Wealth in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your money rises and falls with each decade.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your finances follow no single pattern from birth, and you trust one good year less than most people do. Some decades bring money in and others drain it, and you notice the turn before anyone around you does.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2003 to 2012
sections.text: Contest sharpened the way you handled money in those years, and you went after the same chances others wanted. You did best with a rival close by, and you learned exactly what your effort was worth.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Chances multiply in these years and spread you thin, with more offers and requests than you can follow. One reliable source keeps paying while the others rise and fall, and you come through with your savings intact.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)

sections.text: Caution about money tightens in these years, and spending on yourself feels wrong more often than it should. You have more put by than you feel you have, and you relax a little each time you check.

sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Five seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your home runs on kept promises.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You run your household on clear duties and fair rules, and the people in it know what to expect. Because order is how you protect the people you love, you notice a broken promise at home faster than a kind word. Your family feels secure with you, and some of them wish you were less strict.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: An older relative in your first home made a point of standing on their own, and you copied it before you understood it. You asked for less with each year you grew, and the adults around you praised you for it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: In your first home someone gave you books, questions or long silences in place of the usual fuss, often an adult who lived in their own head. By your teens you had learned to answer your own questions, and you asked for help less than other children did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: Your family life has been built on structure, regular meals and shared duties and arrangements that hold. Relatives on both sides have come to trust your household, and you have been the one who keeps its promises when others forgot.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your family gathers around what you give, the meals and the gifts and the time. Younger people grow easy and generous around you, and you see the best of yourself in them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you organise their own lives around what you have arranged. You share more of your stories with them in these years, and they come to know you as well as they trust you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1999 to 2008
sections.text: Duty at home outweighed pleasure in those years, and you counted what others spent without meaning to. The household stayed secure and a little tense, and you were carried by one relative who thanked you plainly.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2009 to 2018
sections.text: Plans and people far from home pulled you away in those years, and your family saw less of you than they wanted. You made it up in bursts of generosity, and you came through on a family that forgave more than you expected.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2019 to 2028 · now
sections.text: Obligations at home pile up in these years, with duties to the people who rely on you and a family name to protect. You meet them faithfully, and you guard a part of your life that belongs to you alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2039 to 2048
sections.text: Family support reaches you in these ten years, as advice, practical help or a place to come back to. You receive more care than you expected, and you return it to the people who gave it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Twin stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your family raised you to stand on your own. As a child you were noticed for being capable, and help at home was something you earned. Because managing alone won you approval early, people still meet that capable face first, and friends trust you to carry your share. Asking your family or anyone else for something has stayed the hardest thing you do, and you go without more often than the people around you guess.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was care that came in unusual forms. As a child you were loved through books or silence or an adult who cared for you in ideas more than in hugs. Because you learned early to feed your own mind, you have depended on yourself for understanding ever since. You grew up through odd subjects and unlikely teachers, at a pace nobody at home could set for you. Time alone still restores you in a way company never quite does, and you are used to being slightly apart.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: you love seriously, with promises meant to last. You want love that is committed and clear, with a partner whose word holds as firmly as yours. Because keeping promises is how you show care, you judge a partner from the start by what they do on ordinary days. Over time that seriousness turns part of your love into routine, and the warmth goes quiet before you notice. The home you build with a partner becomes the steadiest place in your family, and you keep it that way on purpose.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later years are known for what you make and give. In later life people see you cooking, mending or teaching for others, and children or younger relatives or someone you train pick up your skills along with your generosity. Because being useful puts you at ease, you keep making things for the pleasure of it and passing on what your hands know. Comfort that asks nothing of you is the one thing that slows your work, and you notice it in the weeks with no one to make anything for.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years rest on a quiet sense of duty done well. You want your affairs settled and your debts paid, and an unanswered letter stays on your mind until it is done. Because keeping your word is how you feel at peace, you finish what you owe before you allow yourself to rest. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, trust that your arrangements will hold. Your growth in later life comes from the few things you value, done a little better each year.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your career grows steadily inside a structure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You do your best work inside an organisation with fixed rules and a visible ladder, and you climb it by doing every step properly. Because you need to know where you stand, open-ended jobs leave you uneasy, and a proper title settles you. What you gain is lasting rank, and what you lose is the freedom to move quickly.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also polish your work in private until the moment to show it has passed, and you lose more chances by not finishing than by failing.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Through your first working years your best jobs were the ones you enjoyed, and your worst stretches were the ones you forced yourself through. At least once a parent or an older colleague took your ease for a lack of drive, and you proved them wrong quietly.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Each step up since your late teens has come after you proved you could do the last one properly, and you waited to feel ready before you asked for the next. Your seniors noticed your reliability early, and you were trusted with more than your age suggested.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Career seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties your private life has taken more of your energy than your career, and you have pushed for less at work than you could.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Your working life turns productive in the ways that suit you from your late forties, through mentoring and making and work done for others. You do some of your best work in these years, and you are paid for it in thanks as well as money.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1999 to 2008
sections.text: Safety kept you in one place too long during those years, and your duties grew faster than your reward. You carried the extra load reliably, and it earned you a trust that later work paid for.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2019 to 2028 · now
sections.text: Hierarchy presses on your work in these ten years, and each new duty adds to rules that are already strict. Your good name holds throughout, and what carries you is the part of the work you shape yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2029 to 2038
sections.text: Demands pile up in your work through these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing holds through the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2049 to 2058
sections.text: Unusual knowledge brings you work in these years, through research, advice or technical skill. People come to you for what others do not know, and your name grows inside a small field.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2059 to 2068
sections.text: Joint efforts carry your work in these ten years, and you do best inside a group with something to win. You compete hard and share credit fairly, and the people beside you back you for it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

You coast through a smooth year without noticing, and you feel the cost only when it ends.

Because steady reliability earns trust, your responsibilities grow year by year, and each new rank teaches you what the last one could not. Among friends you end up making the plans and keeping the dates, and you are relied on more than thanked.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Love in your chart. One sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You love with promises, and you keep them.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are drawn to partners with clear values, people who keep their word and expect you to keep yours. Because reliability is what love means to you, you trust slowly and commit fully, and you find casual romance empty. What you want is a partner you can count on for life, and you give the same in return.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: The relationships that mattered to you have been serious from early on, with plans made and promises kept. At least once you stayed loyal to a commitment after the feeling had faded, and you were slow to admit it.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Love has no decade of its own. The pattern your Day Gate set is the one your love life keeps.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: you love seriously, with promises meant to last. You want love that is committed and clear, with a partner whose word holds as firmly as yours. Because keeping promises is how you show care, you judge a partner from the start by what they do on ordinary days. Over time that seriousness turns part of your love into routine, and the warmth goes quiet before you notice. The home you build with a partner becomes the steadiest place in your family, and you keep it that way on purpose.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Mind in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: You taught yourself most of what you know.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You learn best alone, from books and odd sources and your own testing, at a pace no class has ever matched. Because nobody handed you a set path, you trust the understanding you dig out yourself, and you forget what you were simply told. You know a great deal that you have never shown anyone.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: Whatever you were given to read when you were small, you read past it into subjects nobody around you shared. By your teens you knew more about a few odd things than most adults did, and you mentioned it only to the one or two people who asked.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Mind seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have used your mind for practical problems more than for ideas, and reading and study have had less of your week than they once did.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Mind seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2039 to 2048
sections.text: Learning comes easily in these years, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, and you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2049 to 2058
sections.text: Your intuition is sharp in these ten years, and unusual ideas find a use. You think in ways few others do, and people come to you for the angle they missed.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Sage year
sections.text: Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was care that came in unusual forms. As a child you were loved through books or silence or an adult who cared for you in ideas more than in hugs. Because you learned early to feed your own mind, you have depended on yourself for understanding ever since. You grew up through odd subjects and unlikely teachers, at a pace nobody at home could set for you. Time alone still restores you in a way company never quite does, and you are used to being slightly apart.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: No seat rules Health in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your health moves with the decade you are in.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your health has no fixed pattern of its own. You feel well for some stretches of years and worn for others, and the change has no obvious cause because the decade is what moves it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: In your heaviest thinking seasons you also forget to eat and sleep properly, and your body tells you before your mind admits it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2029 to 2038
sections.text: Pressure costs you sleep and energy through these years, and short nights add up faster than you notice. What carries you is sleep and slow meals given their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2039 to 2048
sections.text: Support and good rest restore you in these ten years, and recovery from strain comes faster than before. You sleep well and eat well, and your energy holds steady through the decade.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Five seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You become the host your family returns to.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your home is where your family ends up, for meals and holidays and the nights someone needs a bed. Because a full house makes you feel settled, you take on more hosting than anyone asks of you. Relatives treat your door as always open, and you rarely show them how tired you are by the end.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and promises kept, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You questioned at least one rule in your first home that everyone else accepted, quietly or out loud. Someone there found you difficult for it, and by your teens you had learned which opinions to keep to yourself.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · now
sections.text: Wherever you have lived so far, people have drifted to your kitchen for a meal or a night or a long weekend. You have fed more people than you could easily afford to, and you have counted it as time well spent.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: The people after you take their idea of independence from you, and from your late forties they watch how you manage more closely than they say. You teach them most by example, and the few words you add mean more to them than you expect.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you settle in different places and keep you travelling to see them. You become the reason they meet, and you find the gatherings worth more to you than anything you could buy them.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Your family sheltered you in those years more than you needed, and the care came with expectations. You kept the peace by doing what was expected, and what carried you was one thing you chose for yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Order and good manners shaped your home in those years, and everyone knew their place and their duties. You earned respect in your family by keeping its rules, and you felt secure inside them.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Keeping the household in order weighs on you in these years, and you carry more of it than your share. The order you built keeps you going, and you pass some of the load over once your family sees it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2064 to 2073
sections.text: Your household is softer in these ten years, with shared meals and unhurried weekends. You make the home a comfortable place, and relatives come to you because it feels good to be there.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, and you spend more of your time and money on people beyond your own home.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept. You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood ran a quiet disagreement with the way things were done at home. You asked why before most children do, and the habit of doubting first has stayed with you. Because you learned early to trust your own judgement over what you were told, you have grown fastest in places that let you test things for yourself. Some in your family took your honesty for defiance, and you are closest now to the relatives who heard you out.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life is built around comfort shared at home. You are happiest where food, rest and easy company are part of every day, and you choose a partner who enjoys them with you. Because ease makes you feel safe, you look after the people you live with through meals and small favours more than through words. Your relatives and friends end up at your table, and you give so much to the household that your own rest comes last.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Twin stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see you run your later life on your own terms. In later life you run your own affairs and turn down help politely, and the people around you notice. Because standing on your own is how you show who you are, children or younger relatives or someone you train learn self-reliance from watching you. You go on learning new skills long after most people stop. You pay for that independence with a distance the young find hard to cross.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years runs a wish to keep moving and keep meeting people. In later life you want plans on the calendar and people arriving from far away. Because new places and new company keep you lively, a quiet year weighs on you more than a busy one, and you spend on trips without much counting. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, pick up some of your restlessness as your family gathers in bursts. You count those gatherings as your real wealth, and you pay for most of them yourself.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes in strong seasons and quiet ones.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You earn in bursts, a run of good months and a quiet stretch after. Because each good season makes you sure of the next, you spend the winnings on a new chance before you have kept any. You are richer in the middle of each lucky stretch than after it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You learned what things cost before most children do. Money at home was counted and spent with care, and by your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: What you have earned since your late teens has followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. At least once you have lost the gains of a good year by chasing a better one, and you have learned how your own luck runs.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have put home and your own life before earning more, and money has stayed something you manage more than something you build.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: Chances to earn keep reaching you from your late forties, through younger people or through a move. Your money stays lively in these years, and you sleep best when one part of it never moves.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Caution about money tightens in these years, and spending on yourself feels wrong more often than it should. You have more put by than you feel you have, and you relax a little each time you check.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Chances multiply in these years and spread you thin, with more offers and requests than you can follow. One reliable source keeps paying while the others rise and fall, and you come through with your savings intact.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept. You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Month Gate: under your working years runs a quiet sense of where value is about to move. You sense where prices and people and fashions are heading before most of the people around you, and you build your work on that instinct. Because you trust it more than any plan, you earn in waves, with strong seasons followed by flat ones. Each good run makes you want a bigger one, and the gains go back into the next chance. You keep most in the years when someone patient holds what you bring in.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years runs a wish to keep moving and keep meeting people. In later life you want plans on the calendar and people arriving from far away. Because new places and new company keep you lively, a quiet year weighs on you more than a busy one, and you spend on trips without much counting. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, pick up some of your restlessness as your family gathers in bursts. You count those gatherings as your real wealth, and you pay for most of them yourself.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your work pays for reading where things are going.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are drawn to work where timing matters, buying and selling or finding things before others notice them. Because you read change early, a job where nothing moves bores you, and you leave it sooner than you planned. In any role you end up as the person who sees what is coming next.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You are also paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing. In you the gap is short, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Since your late teens you have been the one handed the job nobody else would finish alone. You have changed teams or roles at least once because someone else took the credit for your work.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: The jobs that have gone best for you since your late teens are the ones where you could spot a trend early, in sales or trading or finding the right people. More than once you have left a steady job because it gave your instinct nothing to do.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Career seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties your private life has taken more of your energy than your career, and you have pushed for less at work than you could.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Career seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Those years pulled you toward study and odd side paths more than toward steady work. You learned a great deal that did not pay at the time, and you got through on the one skill people kept asking you for.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Recognition came the proper way in those years, through good work noticed by the right people. You earned a place you could be proud of, and you carried the responsibility well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: You take on hard assignments and real pressure in these years, and you rise because of them. You come out of the decade with more authority than you went in with.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Routine tightens around your work in these years, and caution keeps you from moves that would pay more. Your reliability keeps you valued, and you find a better fit once someone else sees what you are worth.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2054 to 2063
sections.text: Original work brings you recognition in these ten years. You win people over by doing what others will not, and your reputation grows on your own terms.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2064 to 2073
sections.text: A craft or skill you enjoy is what pays in these ten years. People come back for what you make, and you do your best work at an easy pace.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Twin stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are seen as the one who carries their own weight. You built your working life on your own effort, and the people around you have always seen it. Because doing it yourself is how you stay sure of your worth, you take whole tasks and sign your name to them, and you stall wherever credit is shared loosely. You keep your equals close at work, and you have quietly let go of everyone who treated you as junior.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Month Gate: under your working years runs a quiet sense of where value is about to move. You sense where prices and people and fashions are heading before most of the people around you, and you build your work on that instinct. Because you trust it more than any plan, you earn in waves, with strong seasons followed by flat ones. Each good run makes you want a bigger one, and the gains go back into the next chance. sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grow by doubting what you are given.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You improve anything you are handed by questioning it first, a method or a belief or a piece of advice. Since accepting things whole has never felt honest to you, you learn more slowly from teachers and faster from your own mistakes. Your doubt turns into skill whenever it has real work in front of it, and you grow restless when it has none.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You had outgrown some of what your family believed by your teens, and you got there by arguing with it. In school you did best in the subjects that let you question the answer, and you drifted through the ones that did not.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have kept to what you already do well, and you have started fewer new things than in any years before.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties you keep learning in plain view, and younger people copy the habit from you. You become the person they point to when they talk about starting something new, and you are admired for it more than anyone says.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: You grew in those years by going your own way, often away from what was expected of you. The progress was real and nearly invisible, and you kept going on your own conviction while you felt behind.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: You grow fastest in these years through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You come out of the decade stronger in the places that used to hold you back.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood ran a quiet disagreement with the way things were done at home. You asked why before most children do, and the habit of doubting first has stayed with you. Because you learned early to trust your own judgement over what you were told, you have grown fastest in places that let you test things for yourself. Some in your family took your honesty for defiance, and you are closest now to the relatives who heard you out.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Twin stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see you run your later life on your own terms. In later life you run your own affairs and turn down help politely, and the people around you notice. Because standing on your own is how you show who you are, children or younger relatives or someone you train learn self-reliance from watching you. You go on learning new skills long after most people stop. You pay for that independence with a distance the young find hard to cross.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Social in your chart. One sits in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your friends are your equals, or they drift.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You choose friends who match you, people who carry their own weight and expect you to carry yours. Because you measure everyone against your own standard, you drift from anyone who leans on you, and you rarely say why. You keep a small circle, and you keep it for years.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your friendships since your late teens have been between equals, often with one friend who mirrors you like a sibling. More than once you have lent money or time to a friend and found it harder to talk about than the friendship could bear.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Social seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties your evenings have gone to home and work more than to friends, and you have watched your circle thin without anyone deciding it.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Social seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Respect came to you in those years through how you conducted yourself among others. People saw you as fair and dependable, and you were asked to lead more than once.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: You meet more people in these years than you can keep up with, and old friends see less of you. A small group who knew you before this busy decade stays close, and you return to them again and again.

sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Five seats rule Mind in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, two in your Rising Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your mind never stops improving what it sees.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You think in revisions, turning over a plan or an idea or your own opinion until it is better, and nothing feels quite finished to you. Since a fault you have noticed stays with you until it is mended, your mind keeps working when the day is over. You sleep best in the weeks when one hard problem has all of your attention.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: Whatever you were given to read when you were small, you read past it into subjects nobody around you shared. By your teens you knew more about a few odd things than most adults did, and you mentioned it only to the one or two people who asked.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your thinking has set you apart at work since your late teens, quick to spot the flaw and slow to explain it. You have left more than one project half finished because the interesting part was solved, and the finishing bored you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your mind has gone looking for faults since your late teens, in what you were taught and in what you believed yourself. You have changed your view on something important more than once over those years, and each time you argued yourself into the new view first.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Mind seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have used your mind for practical problems more than for ideas, and reading and study have had less of your week than they once did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your mind keeps sharpening, and you take on questions you once put aside. You do some of your best thinking in these years, and it reaches further once someone younger helps you put it into words.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2039 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your thinking gets bolder past your late forties, and you say plainly what you held back in earlier years. An idea that grips you keeps you up at night, and you sleep well again once you have said it out loud.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2017 to 2026 · now
sections.text: You argue with more of what you are told in these years, and every rule you meet feels like a challenge. One piece of work big enough to take all that argument carries you through, and you are calmest on the days you finish something.

sections.text: The Alchemist lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was care that came in unusual forms. sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the specialist nobody quite understands. Because your thinking catches what training does not teach, you are paid for insight more than for hours, and you do your best work with quiet and freedom. The same oddness keeps you outside the circle that hands out promotions. You are remembered for the problem you solved, and you are left out of the meeting after it.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

Because an unfixed flaw weighs on you more than hard work does, you keep improving things long after others call them finished, and you are still thinking about them at night. Managers find you tiring and colleagues find you useful, and you are proud of being both.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people come to you for what few others know. Because your insight keeps growing with use, your strongest ideas and your most valued work come after your late forties. The younger people who seek you out, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn from you what no course offered them. You are consulted far more than you are kept company, and your method stays unwritten for longer than it should.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: You are best in jobs where improving things is the work itself, editing or design or reform of some kind. Your value at work grows with every process you improve, and you are known as the colleague who will not let poor work pass.

sections.text: Work with an odd corner to it has drawn you since your late teens, a niche most people around you ignored. You have been passed over at least once for someone easier to explain, and you have been called back later to fix what they could not.

sections.text: In class, in teams and in your first jobs you have been the one who points out what could be better. You have clashed with at least one boss over it, and you have also been the person they sent for when something needed fixing.

sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.text: Your savings grow quietly, year after year.

sections.text: You save a part of everything you earn, and a steady rise in your accounts pleases you more than any windfall. Because security is what you are working for, you avoid risks that would make you rich quickly. Your caution keeps you safe, and you feel a good year as relief more than as joy.

sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.text: You saw money borrowed and lent around the family as a child, and little of it was written down. Before you were grown you had given away more than you could spare, and you had learned which relatives paid you back.

sections.text: Even in lean months you have put money aside since your late teens, and your savings have grown more than people expected. You have turned down at least one exciting offer because it asked too much risk.

Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.

sections.text: Friends and colleagues either love you or resist you.

sections.text: Your friendships since your late teens have formed around strong reactions, people who liked your edge at once or never warmed to it. More than once a friendship ended over something you said in public, and you have kept every friend who stayed through it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You see the pattern before others have finished explaining it, and boredom reaches you long before the lesson ends. Since your thinking was praised early for speed, you are careless with the slower parts of a problem. Your mind does its best work on hard problems with someone watching, and you drift when it has neither.

sections.text: You finished the work early at school and went looking for something harder, or for trouble when nothing harder came. Before you left school you had taught yourself at least one subject well beyond your class, and you had learned to hide how bored you were.

sections.head: GAP ROW

sections.text: Learning comes easily in these years, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, and you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2059 to 2068
sections.text: Your intuition is sharp in these ten years, and unusual ideas find a use. You think in ways few others do, and people come to you for the angle they missed.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Sage year
sections.text: Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: you were known early as the bright child who answered back. In class you spotted the flaw in a lesson and said so before the teacher had finished. Because your mind moves faster than others expect, the company you keep sorts quickly into those who enjoy you and those who resent you. Teachers and older relatives were the first to feel both reactions, and you have done better each time you picked your own friends and your own work.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your work is only as good as your sleep.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your body and your work move together, and both run best on regular meals, real rest and a steady routine. Because food and rest are pleasures to you, you eat late and sleep short in busy months, and your energy drops. You notice tiredness in your work before you feel it, and a few good nights put it right.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You were a tough child, slow to complain and quick to hide a bad night from the adults. Your reserves got you through hard weeks most children did not have to face, and you learned early to run on them.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Good care kept you well in those years, with regular meals, early nights and someone who noticed when you were tired. You recovered quickly from strain, and you felt safe in your body.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)

sections.text: Pressure costs you sleep and energy through these years, and short nights add up faster than you notice. What carries you is sleep and slow meals given their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.
