sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.text: Your best work comes from skill built slowly, in fields where the hands or the senses know things. Since steady practice is what you trust, you are slow to take on work you cannot yet do well, and you miss a few openings that way. You are seldom the loudest on a team, and your work is the work that holds up.

sections.text: Since your late teens your growth has looked slow from the outside, years spent studying or testing or changing direction while friends settled. Most of what you can do now, you taught yourself in those years.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: You grow from your late forties by staying involved, advising and backing people who are still at the start. Their risks keep your mind quick in these years, and you take more chances with your own plans than you did a decade earlier.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2040 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your growth from your late forties lies in refining what you already know, until years of odd learning come down to a few clear ideas. You pass those ideas to younger people in plain words, and you see them used long after you worked them out.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Challenges shaped you in those years, and each hard test left you more capable than before. You learned to face pressure directly, and the courage you built has stayed with you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2058 to 2067
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. One equal who works beside you instead of against you keeps you going, and you grow because of it.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The General inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The General lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years was a weight you carried quietly. Your first home asked a lot of you as a child, and you gave it more strength than anyone thought to ask about. Because you had to be strong early, you learned to stay calm in a crisis and uneasy when life goes easy. The same strength left a habit of carrying everything alone, and you still keep your tiredness to yourself. Each hard stretch since has added to what you can carry, and you are steadier for it.

Because you trust what you have worked out yourself more than what you were taught, you look quiet from outside while the real work happens inside. You found your important teachers off the usual path, and you are slowly becoming the odd teacher someone else needs.

sections.text: The Rival stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people see your nerve and ask you to back them. sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Everyone trusts you with the responsible job.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your friends and colleagues hand you the keys, the calendar and the emergency. Because people trust you on sight, you get the duty along with the respect, and you rarely refuse it. Your social life runs on reliability, and you have less time for fun than the people who lean on you.

sections.text: Other children took a while to warm to you as a child, because you stood at the edge of groups for a long time first. By your teens you had one or two close friends who understood you, and they were enough for you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: From your late teens you have been the dependable one in every group, the friend who organised and the colleague who covered. At least once that role cost you a weekend or a holiday you had planned for yourself, and you gave it up without complaint.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape your next twenty years through someone you share a home with.

sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2048 to 2057
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend often.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2058 to 2067
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: as a child you were seen as watchful, deep and a little apart. Because you took in the world on your own terms, teachers found you older than your years and other children found you hard to read. That early difference still shapes how people see you, thoughtful and selective and slow to open up. You let a few friends close in place of a crowd, and you have not regretted the trade.

In your circle you are the one made responsible, the person others call when something must be done properly. Your name matters more than your pay in these years, and over time it raises your pay as well.

Your home years open wider than any before them, and you share them with a person whose world is bigger than your own.

sections.text: Teachers and neighbours trusted you as a child, partly because of the family you came from. By your teens you were the one picked to lead or to represent the group, and you felt the weight of behaving well.

sections.text: From your late teens you have made friends through competition, in teams and courses and workplaces where everyone was ranked. More than once a friendship ended when you won, and you have kept the rival who took a loss well.

sections.text: Past your late forties your community keeps giving you positions of trust, a committee or a board or a role as the steady voice. You are honoured more in these years than in your busiest working ones, and you choose carefully which causes get your name.

sections.text: In company you were the lively one in those years, quick with a joke and a sharp opinion. People sought you out for your wit, and you enjoyed being heard.

sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

Because loyalty to the person beside you outweighs any careful plan, the shared accounts blur and the arguments arrive later. You stay calmest about money when your share and theirs are kept apart, and you seldom manage it.

sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.text: You kept coins and small earnings longer than your friends did as a child, and nobody had to tell you to. You learned early that money kept quietly was money that stayed, and you have never lost the habit.

You keep the peace best where each of you holds an account of your own, and the arguments turn back to love.

You become known for a rare kind of knowledge, and people with odd problems come looking for you. Because your insight keeps growing with use, your strongest ideas and your most valued work come after your late forties. The younger people who seek you out, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn from you what no course offered them. You are consulted far more than you are kept company, and your method stays unwritten for longer than it should.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The General inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The General lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years keep a private discipline that never quite stops. In later life you keep habits others let slip, the early start and the standard kept. Because being strong is how you feel safe, you push on past the point where others would ease off, and rest comes hard to you. The younger ones in your life, children or younger relatives or someone you train, feel protected by you more than held. You grow each time you take on something hard, and your strength holds because you use it.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your savings grow quietly, year after year.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You save a part of everything you earn, and a steady rise in your accounts pleases you more than any windfall. Because security is what you are working for, you avoid risks that would make you rich quickly. Your caution keeps you safe, and you feel a good year as relief more than as joy.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: The money you have counted on since your late teens is the salary, raised a step at a time and planned for well in advance. You have kept to your own plan while friends chased quick gains, and you have rarely regretted it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: Even in lean months you have put money aside since your late teens, and your savings have grown more than people expected. You have turned down at least one exciting offer because it asked too much risk.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Wealth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2001 to 2010
sections.text: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2031 to 2040
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

Because you trust only what you have earned yourself, you turn down quick gains that would ask you to become someone else. Your progress at work looks slow at first and surprises people later. The cost is a tight grip, and you take less pleasure in what you have built than it could give you.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Health in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your body stays strong on routine.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You treat your body as something to keep in working order, with a fixed hour to rise and a daily walk or workout. Because strength is part of how you see yourself, you ignore tiredness until it slows you down. Your energy is at its best when the week has a shape.

sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your body has come second to work and study, and you have been spending the reserve your childhood gave you.

sections.text: From your late forties your health rests on routine, and a steady week keeps you fitter than most people your age. Days with no shape drain your energy and ordered ones bring it back, and you feel the difference within a week.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Social in your chart. One sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your friends are shared, few and loyal.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your closest friends are the ones you and a partner both respect, other couples and old friends who treat your home as a unit. Because respect is what keeps you close to anyone, you let wider acquaintances fade without a word. You keep a small circle, and you can say why each person in it is there.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Social seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put study, work and family before friendship, and your circle has stayed smaller than the people around you expected.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2028 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your circle becomes a shared one, friends who know the two of you as a pair. You spend these years with fewer people than before, and you trust each of them more.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2001 to 2010
sections.text: Acquaintances crowded those years, and you knew people in many places without letting many of them close. One old friend who stayed kept you steady, and you confided in that friend more than in anyone new.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2011 to 2020
sections.text: In company you were the lively one in those years, quick with a joke and a sharp opinion. People sought you out for your wit, and you enjoyed being heard.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2031 to 2040
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend often.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2041 to 2050
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and friends of friends, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.text: The Twin lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: you love as an equal, and only as an equal. At home you want two people deciding and neither one in charge, and you lose patience with a partner who leans on you for every choice. Because equality is how you feel respected, you track who conceded the last argument, and you rarely say so. Your friendships run on the same level terms, and you keep the friends a partner also respects. You grow easier about being looked after once someone has proved they stand level with you.

sections.text: You were fed well, and you became the one who feeds.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You hold your family together through comfort, the visit kept and the favour done and the table set. Because care reached you first as warmth, you give it back the same way, and you feel useless in a family crisis that kindness cannot touch. What you want from your family is ease, and you work hard to make it.

sections.text: An older relative in your first home, a parent or someone who stood in for one, spent widely and drew people around them. Growing up you learned both the warmth of that generosity and what it cost the household.

sections.text: You work best with something real at stake.

sections.text: You are at your sharpest in jobs with clear stakes, sales or ventures or anything where the score is public. Because you need to feel the risk to feel awake, you move first and sort out the rest afterwards. Your bold moves pay best beside a colleague who checks the details, and you have little patience for the checking yourself.

sections.text: You have been given responsibility early in every job since your late teens, a budget or a set of keys or a team's accounts. Your promotions have come steadily, each one a little later than your work deserved.

sections.sub: The Steward at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the one trusted with the money. You are handed the budget, the accounts and the jobs that need order in every place you work. Because being relied on is how you prove your worth, you take on other people's messes and sort them without fuss. Your income rises on a steady schedule, and your standing rises with it. You are needed everywhere at work, and you are thanked less than you are used.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Rival holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years are built on risk and on people who share it. Underneath what you do for a living is a need to have something at stake, and waiting has always felt riskier than acting. Because you measure yourself against the people beside you, you do your best work where results are counted in public and shared with partners. Your colleagues and your friends end up as one circle, and your income arrives in surges that you spend on them as fast as it comes. You build more than you keep, and it rarely troubles you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The General at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The General stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people see your authority before your warmth. You keep working under pressure in later life, and people go on bringing you the hard problems because you still take them. Because demanding work is how you know you matter, stopping feels like losing your place, and you keep growing in how calmly you carry the load. You set the standard for the people who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, and they respect you more than they relax around you.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your body trusts food and rest to put it right.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You trust your body to fix itself with a good meal and a long sleep, and for most of your life it has. Because comfort is how you recover, you reach for it under stress, and you turn the extra helping or the lost weekend into a habit before you notice. Your body asks you for rhythm more than for effort.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You were a child who recovered quickly, from colds and falls and bad days alike. Your appetite and your sleep were steady, and you came into adulthood with more reserve than most of the people around you.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your body has come second to work and study, and you have been spending the reserve your childhood gave you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2041 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your body repays the care you keep giving it from your late forties, with steady energy and good sleep. You stay strong in these years, and you feel the benefit of every ordinary habit.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Your body answered strain well in those years, and hard training or hard work made you stronger. You had energy for demanding days, and you recovered fast between them.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: Too much rest dulls you in these years, and comfortable days leave your energy low. What carries you is regular movement and a reason to get up early, and you feel better each time you have one.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years were comfort and care, given freely. As a child you were fed well, in more than one sense, and that early comfort still sits under the way you live. Because ease was given to you before you had to earn it, you recover through simple things, food and a full night's sleep and the company of people you love. Whatever else your first home held, you took from it a store of warmth you have drawn on in every hard season since.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years sits a quiet habit of keeping everything provided for. In later life you want things settled, with savings kept, care arranged and nothing left to chance. Because providing is how you love, you make arrangements for others long before they are needed, and you keep your own sleep and meals in the same good order. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn thrift by watching you. Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Work and friendship are one circle for you.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your friends and colleagues are mostly the same people, and you go into business with the ones you like. Because you trust the people you enjoy, you agree to shared plans before the terms are clear. When one of those plans fails, you lose the friend along with the money.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your closest friends since your late teens have also been the people you worked or did deals with. At least one friendship of yours ended over a shared venture, and you still count the friend as a loss more than the money.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: From your mid-thirties your circle becomes a shared one, friends who know the two of you as a pair. You spend these years with fewer people than before, and you trust each of them more.

sections.text: Your circle spread wide in those years, through travel, work and friends of friends. You met people easily everywhere you went, and several of them opened doors for you.

sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Respect came to you in those years through how you conducted yourself among others. People saw you as fair and dependable, and you were asked to lead more than once.

sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend often.

sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and friends of friends, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: You grow by using your strength with more care.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You change by getting better at pressure, using less force to get the same result. Because you have tested yourself so many times, you know your limits well, and you spend your energy where it counts. You lose your temper less than you did, and you win more arguments by waiting.

sections.head: GAP ROW

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: You work best when the whole job is yours.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You take a task from start to finish and want your name on the result. Because your sense of worth comes from your own output, you lose energy fast in any job where freedom exists only on paper. Your output rises with every piece of real freedom you get, and a manager who checks in daily costs you more than a lower salary would.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, you do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your reputation at work has grown out of hard moments since your late teens, the emergency handled or the project rescued. You were promoted at least once for the steadiness you showed in a bad week.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: You have chosen work you could own outright since your late teens, even when a shared role paid better. At least once you left a job because the freedom it promised was only for show, and you have not regretted it.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Career seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Recognition came the proper way in those years, through good work noticed by the right people. You earned a place you could be proud of, and you carried the responsibility well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: Your work pays properly in these years, steadily and in proportion to what you put in. You chase the next thing less and build on what you already do well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: A craft or skill you enjoy is what pays in these ten years. People come back for what you make, and you do your best work at an easy pace.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Original work brings you recognition in these ten years. You win people over by doing what others will not, and your reputation grows on your own terms.

sections.sub: 2027 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Your work turns toward study and specialist skill this year, and you learn more out of sight than you earn in plain view.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.text: The General stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work people see someone who can handle pressure. Authority shows on you before you say a word, and you are handed the hard jobs early. Because you meet pressure head on, you rise fastest in work with real stakes, and the crises that break others build your name. The friends you keep are mostly people who went through a hard stretch beside you, and colleagues respect you before they warm to you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Twin holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years run on your own effort. Under everything you do at work sits a need to own it, the skill and the result and the name on it. Because depending on anyone feels like losing yourself, you have built your working life on effort nobody else can claim. You learn the same way, slowly and in full, until a skill is yours to the last detail. You finish later than you would beside one trusted colleague, and you accept the delay as the price of owning the result.

sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Your family life settles in these years around the order you keep, a home that runs well and bills paid on time. You are the one your relatives rely on, and you are glad to be.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Your household is softer in these ten years, with shared meals and unhurried weekends. You make the home a comfortable place, and relatives come to you because it feels good to be there.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2064 to 2073
sections.text: Pride runs through your family in these years, and each person insists on doing things their own way. The quarrels shrink once everyone has a clear part, and you come through by doing yours without keeping score.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Twin year
sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept. You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was real care, steady enough to trust. Someone in your first home gave you decent, patient care, and the ease it gave you became the way you meet the world. Because care reached you early, you trust people first, and you find the protective ones quickly. The same safety made leaving it hard, and you have stayed in comfortable places longer than they helped you grow. You still sleep and eat better after a hard season once you are back with the people who love you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later years are known for what you make and give. In later life people see you cooking, mending or teaching for others, and children or younger relatives or someone you train pick up your skills along with your generosity. Because being useful puts you at ease, you keep making things for the pleasure of it and passing on what your hands know. Comfort that asks nothing of you is the one thing that slows your work, and you notice it in the weeks with no one to make anything for.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years rest on a quiet sense of duty done well. You want your affairs settled and your debts paid, and an unanswered letter stays on your mind until it is done. Because keeping your word is how you feel at peace, you finish what you owe before you allow yourself to rest. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, trust that your arrangements will hold. Your growth in later life comes from the few things you value, done a little better each year.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your career rises on what you have studied.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are trusted at work because you know your subject properly, and people check their facts with you. Because depth matters more to you than visibility, you leave the self-promotion to others, and promotion reaches you later than it should. Your standing grows slowly and holds when louder careers fall away.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You are also paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Older people at work have backed you since your late teens, vouched for you or quietly put your name forward. You have collected qualifications and references in those years that still carry weight wherever you apply, and you have needed to push less than most.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: Your progress at work since your late teens has come through what you studied, each qualification earned before you asked for the next step. At least once someone senior put your name forward before you felt ready, and you have proved them right.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2042 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Your working life turns productive in the ways that suit you from your late forties, through mentoring and making and work done for others. You do some of your best work in these years, and you are paid for it in thanks as well as money.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Hard tasks found you in those years, and you met pressure that would have stopped most people. You rose by handling it, and you learned your strength in the worst weeks.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Recognition came the proper way in those years, through good work noticed by the right people. You earned a place you could be proud of, and you carried the responsibility well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Your work pays properly in these years, steadily and in proportion to what you put in. You chase the next thing less and build on what you already do well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: A craft or skill you enjoy is what pays in these ten years. People come back for what you make, and you do your best work at an easy pace.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2054 to 2063
sections.text: Original work brings you recognition in these ten years. You win people over by doing what others will not, and your reputation grows on your own terms.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Your work turns toward study and specialist skill this year, and you learn more out of sight than you earn in plain view.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Rival year
sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

Your ability has outrun your confidence for years, and the people who taught you saw it before you did. You grow at your own careful pace, and you are usually the last to see how far you have come.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your growth waits on a readiness you already have.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Each step you take comes after the training is done and the support is in place. Because shelter feels like the right place to prepare, you stay in comfortable roles past the point they teach you anything, and you wait for one more sign that you are ready. You are readier than you feel, and you have been for a long time.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: As a child you tried new things when someone you trusted stood close by, and you held back when nobody did. By your teens you were slower than your friends to try things away from home, because home felt so safe.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: From your late teens you have grown in steady steps, each one taken only after you felt well prepared. You have stayed somewhere safe for longer than it served you at least once, and you did better than you feared once you finally moved.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2042 · inside · coming
sections.text: Past your late forties you keep improving at what you already know, and each year adds polish more than novelty. You grow wiser through repetition and care, and you end up with a character that others hold up as an example.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Challenges shaped you in those years, and each hard test left you more capable than before. You learned to face pressure directly, and the courage you built has stayed with you.

sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. One equal who works beside you instead of against you keeps you going, and you grow because of it.

sections.sub: 2027 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your friends bring you their troubles.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are the friend people confide in, the calm one who listens and gives sound advice. Because being trusted feels like a kind of care to you, you rarely say no, and your evenings fill with other people's problems. You know more about your friends' lives than they know about yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Friends and colleagues have brought you their crises since your late teens, and several of your closest friendships began with someone else's bad news. You have kept more confidences than you can count, and people still repeat what you told them years ago.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2029 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape your next twenty years through someone you share a home with.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Respect came to you in those years through how you conducted yourself among others. People saw you as fair and dependable, and you were asked to lead more than once.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2054 to 2063
sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2064 to 2073
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.text: Roles and expectations shape your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.sub: 2030 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year over the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

Your home years open wider than any before them, and you share them with a person whose world is bigger than your own.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: You learn steadily, and it never stops.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you rarely feel finished. You know far more than you claim to.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Even so, you learn well inside a frame like a school or a discipline, and you keep studying long after the course has ended.

sections.text: From your late teens you took in courses, books and advice from people who knew more, and kept nearly all of it. Over those years you came to know your field better than you let on, and you have rarely made a show of it.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Learning has carried you since your late teens, through courses and qualifications and the teachers who took an interest. You have stayed a student in some form ever since, and it has kept you steadier than most people around you.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your body recovers best when someone looks after you.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You get your energy back quickly after tiring weeks and bad nights, and faster still when someone close is fussing over you. Because care was what restored you from the start, you let yourself rest properly only when another person insists. Your body does well on trust, rest and good company.

sections.text: Whenever you were tired or run down as a child, someone was there with a meal and an early night, and you were yourself again within days. By your teens you had a steady energy the adults around you counted on, and you have kept much of it since.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Mind in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You think alone and speak once you are sure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: For days you turn a problem over before you say a word about it, and you say it only once you have an answer. Because a half-formed thought feels unsafe to you, the people closest to you hear your conclusions without the reasoning. You let a partner further into your thinking than anyone, and even they see only part of it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work. In you this pull is constant, and you feel the tug between thinking and finishing almost every day.

sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you learned in a way teachers struggled to mark, reaching the right answer by a route nobody had taught. By your teens you were known for it, as the clever one or the odd one, and you were both.

sections.text: Since sixteen you have learned by doing more than by study, and your thinking has served your work and friendships more than any subject of its own.

sections.text: From your mid-thirties your thinking deepens and turns toward a single subject you have circled for years. You share more of the work in progress with a partner in these years, and the work gets better for it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: You turned inward in those years, into subjects few people around you shared. You spent long stretches alone with your thinking, and you came out of it with work that still feels like the most important you have done.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: You study more than you act in these years, and your thinking turns cautious. Work that puts what you know to use carries you through, and you trust your own ideas again once you see them working.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2064 to 2073
sections.text: You turn your thinking outward in these years, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against received ideas this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: as a child you were seen as watchful, deep and a little apart. Adults noticed early that you learned differently from other children, and some of them were unsure what to make of it. Because you took in the world on your own terms, teachers found you older than your years and other children found you hard to read. That early difference still shapes how people see you, thoughtful and selective and slow to open up. You let a few friends close in place of a crowd, and you have not regretted the trade.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your closest life keeps a quiet corner of its own. You want someone near and a door you can shut, and you work out what you feel on your own before you say it. Because your thinking runs in private, you bring a partner conclusions more than first reactions, and anyone who reads your quiet as coldness wears you down. You have learned to explain early that the silence is about the problem in front of you. From your mid-thirties you share your home with someone who values how you think.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Love in your chart. One sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You love best with time alone built in.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You want a partner close, and you also want hours each week that belong only to you. Because you sort out your feelings alone, you go quiet before a serious talk, and a partner who presses gets less of you. What you need in love is someone who waits for you to come back.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2029 · inside · coming
sections.text: Through your Home Chapter your household settles around a shared rhythm, with time together and time apart agreed without a fight. You grow closer to a partner in these years by talking through what you have already worked out alone.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Growth in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your growth keeps going when others stop.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You take up new skills in later life with the same seriousness you brought to your first job. Because your own standard is the only one you answer to, you keep raising it long after anyone else is watching. You find it hard to learn beside other people, and you lose some of the help that would come from it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, you grow most through the years that weigh on you, and you have left every heavy stretch more skilled than you entered it.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have grown through work, friends and family more than through any plan to improve yourself, and change has come to you by circumstance.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2042 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties you keep learning in plain view, and younger people copy the habit from you. You become the person they point to when they talk about starting something new, and you are admired for it more than anyone says.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: You grew in those years by going your own way, often away from what was expected of you. The progress was real and nearly invisible, and you kept going on your own conviction while you felt behind.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. One equal who works beside you instead of against you keeps you going, and you grow because of it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Twin stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see you run your later life on your own terms. In later life you run your own affairs and turn down help politely, and the people around you notice. Because standing on your own is how you show who you are, children or younger relatives or someone you train learn self-reliance from watching you. You go on learning new skills long after most people stop. You pay for that independence with a distance the young find hard to cross.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You are paid to make things better.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are best in jobs where improving things is the work itself, editing or design or reform of some kind. Because a weak plan is plain to you before anyone asks, you correct work that was never yours to correct. Your value at work grows with every process you improve, and you are known as the colleague who will not let poor work pass.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your best career moves since your late teens have come through timing, a job heard about early or an offer made in a casual conversation. You have changed direction more than once because a better chance turned up.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: In class, in teams and in your first jobs you have been the one who points out what could be better. You have clashed with at least one boss over it, and you have also been the person they sent for when something needed fixing.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2042 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: The people after you seek out what you know from your late forties, and they bring you the questions their own teachers could not answer. You become the one they consult, and you see your methods carried into work you will never do yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1995 to 2004
sections.text: Safety kept you in one place too long during those years, and your duties grew faster than your reward. You carried the extra load reliably, and it earned you a trust that later work paid for.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2005 to 2014
sections.text: Comfort dulled your drive at work in those years, and easy work held you longer than it should have. You were well liked and under-stretched, and the skill you kept practising for pleasure is what kept you going.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2015 to 2024
sections.text: Clashes with the people in charge marked those years, because you said aloud what others kept quiet. You lost favour more than once, and your skill carried you to the next chance each time.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2035 to 2044
sections.text: Joint efforts carry your work in these ten years, and you do best inside a group with something to win. You compete hard and share credit fairly, and the people beside you back you for it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2045 to 2054
sections.text: Unusual knowledge brings you work in these years, through research, advice or technical skill. People come to you for what others do not know, and your name grows inside a small field.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2065 to 2074
sections.text: Demands pile up in your work through these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing holds through the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Your work turns toward study and specialist skill this year, and you learn more out of sight than you earn in plain view.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Rival year
sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2034 · a Steward year
sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the one who spots the opening first. You find work and money through people, the tip and the contact and the good timing. Because chances reach you that way, you spend your working years meeting people, and your circle and your income grow together. Money comes in through friends and movement, and it leaves the same way, through gifts and plans that drift. You are richest in the years when some of each windfall stays put.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years run on seeing how everything could be better. You spot the better version of a plan, a process or a piece of work almost at once, and the weaker version nags at you for days. Because an unfixed flaw weighs on you more than hard work does, you keep improving things long after others call them finished, and you are still thinking about them at night. Managers find you tiring and colleagues find you useful, and you are proud of being both.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people come to you for what few others know. You become known for a rare kind of knowledge, and people with odd problems come looking for you. Because your insight keeps growing with use, your strongest ideas and your most valued work come after your late forties. The younger people who seek you out, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn from you what no course offered them. You are consulted far more than you are kept company, and your method stays unwritten for longer than it should.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your money arrives in windfalls and leaves through friends.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You earn best from timing, a bonus or a sale or a deal that comes good all at once. Because you trust the next chance to arrive, you spend and lend freely between windfalls. Your money leaves as easily as it arrives, and you notice only when a quiet season comes.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, what you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play. In you the gap is short, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You learned what things cost before most children do. Money at home was counted and spent with care, and by your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Good years and thin ones have followed each other since your late teens, with money arriving in lumps and leaving through generosity. More than once you have spent a windfall on friends and new plans before you set a share of it aside.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Wealth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1995 to 2004
sections.text: Expenses felt heavy in those years, and you counted money long after there was enough. Your savings grew while your pleasure shrank, and you came through on the security that careful habit built.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2035 to 2044
sections.text: Shared money works for you in these ten years, because the contest with others keeps you sharp. You do better with people at your side than alone, and you keep a fair part of what you win together.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2034 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept. You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: You grow best from a safe base.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You take your biggest steps from a secure position, with people behind you and a home to return to. Because safety came first in your life, you learn faster when you feel held, and you stall under pressure from people you do not trust. You put off a change until the support is in place.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: As a child you tried new things when someone you trusted stood close by, and you held back when nobody did. By your teens you were slower than your friends to try things away from home, because home felt so safe.

sections.head: GAP ROW

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2025 to 2034 · now
sections.text: Self-reliance pays in these ten years. You teach yourself what you need and find equals to train beside, and you come out of the decade more capable on your own terms.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2045 to 2054
sections.text: Private study pays in these years, and the things you taught yourself count for more. You grow in directions nobody planned for you, and the progress shows in work only you could do.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2065 to 2074
sections.text: Setbacks arrive in these years without warning, and you are pushed before you feel ready. What carries you is the discipline you already have, and you end the decade tougher in ways that show later.

sections.text: You know someone for every need.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You collect contacts the way other people collect friends, and you love introducing people who should meet. sections.text: Many of your friendships since your late teens began over work, a deal or a shared plan. You have kept in touch with more people than anyone you know, and a few of them have become close for life.

sections.head: NOTE

sections.text: Rivalry turns friendly in these years, and people who compete with you end up on your side. You keep a busy circle through the decade, one where you give and receive in fair measure.

sections.text: Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.sub: 2032 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your family gets your honesty along with your love.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You love your family most easily where you are allowed to disagree, and a home that asks you to keep quiet feels cold to you. Because honesty was your first way of belonging at home, you say what others leave unsaid, and a relative or two finds you hard work. Your warmth is real, and you show it most to the people who argue back.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: An older relative in your first home, a parent or someone who stood in for one, spent widely and drew people around them. Growing up you learned both the warmth of that generosity and what it cost the household.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You questioned at least one rule in your first home that everyone else accepted, quietly or out loud. Someone there found you difficult for it, and by your teens you had learned which opinions to keep to yourself.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Family seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your energy has gone into work and friends more than into family, and you have seen less of your relatives than you meant to.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you rest on the provision you have made. You become the steady one in your family, and you learn in these years to say some of your care out loud.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2007 to 2016
sections.text: Family duty weighed on you in those years, and you met expectations that left you little say. You did what was asked of you well, and you came out of it with the respect it earned you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2017 to 2026 · now
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2027 to 2036

Because care has always meant a good meal and a warm bed to you, you keep feeding whoever comes, whether they are children or younger relatives or someone you train. Ease is both the reward of those years and their one risk, and you stay well for as long as your days keep a rhythm.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Rising Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your work is only as good as your sleep.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your body and your work move together, and both run best on regular meals, real rest and a steady routine. Because food and rest are pleasures to you, you eat late and sleep short in busy months, and your energy drops. You notice tiredness in your work before you feel it, and a few good nights put it right.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use. In you this runs close to the surface, and you turn pressure into calm almost as soon as it lands.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: Your energy has followed your routine closely since your late teens, high in the months you slept and ate well and flat when either slipped. At least once a long stretch of hard work wore you down, and you came back from it through rest more than effort.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2030 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your body becomes the clearest record of how your home is going. You are at your strongest in these years whenever the house is at peace, and every long quarrel costs you rest.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your body settles into an easy routine from your late forties, with good sleep and steady appetite and company at meals. These years suit your body unusually well, and you stay strong in them while there are people around you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Good food and long evenings cost you energy in these years, and the easy option wins more days than it should. You hold steady through a simple routine you enjoy, and you keep to it because it gives you pleasure.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2058 to 2067
sections.text: Support and good rest restore you in these ten years, and recovery from strain comes faster than before. You sleep well and eat well, and your energy holds steady through the decade.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Artisan holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years run on steady craft and a body kept well. You do your work quietly and without fuss, and over the years you produce more than people who make more noise. Because your energy comes from sleep, food and routine, your work rises and falls with how well you are living. You do your best in making, feeding or teaching, and you keep improving at it long after others have peaked.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The General lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your closest bond runs on force and pressure. You are drawn to a partner whose will is as strong as yours, and a calm match has not held you for long. Because pressure is what makes you feel alive, your home life runs hot, and a fight that runs for days shows first in how badly you sleep. You stay longest with a partner who pushes in the same direction as you, toward the work and the home you are building together.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your luck with money improves the further you go.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You find your best chances away from home, in a new city or an unfamiliar market or among strangers. Because familiar places feel small to you, you look outward for money before you look nearby. You earn far from home and feel safe only once the money is back in one place.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, what you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: Money in your family came through moving when you were young, a relative working away or a business that travelled. The first money you made yourself came from beyond your own neighbourhood, and you liked how that felt.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put work, study and friends before money, and your income has stayed below what you could earn.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Wealth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Expenses felt heavy in those years, and you counted money long after there was enough. Your savings grew while your pleasure shrank, and you came through on the security that careful habit built.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Shared money works for you in these ten years, because the contest with others keeps you sharp. You do better with people at your side than alone, and you keep a fair part of what you win together.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your settled surface sits a pull toward somewhere else, carried down your family. Someone in your family left home to look for something better, and you grew up hearing about it. Because moving was part of how your family got by, you feel most alive in unfamiliar places and most at rest when you come back. Your best chances with money come from far off, and you have always needed a fixed home to return to.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Love in your chart. One sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You love people strong enough to push back.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You fall for people with force, the ones who argue their case and refuse to be managed. Because a gentle partner leaves you restless, you bring pressure into love without meaning to, and small disagreements grow into contests. What you want is a partner who matches your strength and turns it toward the world with you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2030 · inside · coming
sections.text: Love asks more of you from your mid-thirties, a shared home and a shared load and the pressure of building both. You come through these years closer to a partner when the two of you turn your strength to the same hard task.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.
