sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, two in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes in bursts, and leaves with friends.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Money reaches you suddenly and leaves with the people you celebrate with, a friend's venture or a round for the table. Because generosity is how you show you belong, you lend before you are asked and count only later. You save less than you mean to in the good years as well as the lean ones, and you feel it most after a win.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You saw money borrowed and lent around the family as a child, and little of it was written down. Before you were grown you had given away more than you could spare, and you had learned which relatives paid you back.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Good years and thin ones have followed each other since your late teens, with money arriving in lumps and leaving through generosity. More than once you have spent a windfall on friends and new plans before you set a share of it aside.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: Your income has arrived unevenly from your late teens, a good year followed by a thin one. More than once you lent or spent a windfall on friends within weeks, and you have mostly not regretted it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · inside · coming
sections.text: Younger people start to make claims on your money from your late forties. You will give more than you planned each time, and you will keep your own floor only where you set the number before anyone asks.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2041 to 2050
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Rival lives inside your Year Gate: in your first home almost everything was shared, and almost everything was claimed. As a child you shared a bed or a bike or a birthday with a brother, sister or cousin who wanted their turn. Because nothing at home stayed yours for long, you learned to give quickly and to keep a quiet count. Your family reaches for your help and your money first, and you say yes before you have worked out what it costs.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the one who spots the opening first. You find work and money through people, the tip and the contact and the good timing. Because chances reach you that way, you spend your working years meeting people, and your circle and your income grow together. Money comes in through friends and movement, and it leaves the same way, through gifts and plans that drift. You are richest in the years when some of each windfall stays put.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Rival holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years are built on risk and on people who share it. Underneath what you do for a living is a need to have something at stake, and waiting has always felt riskier than acting. Because you measure yourself against the people beside you, you do your best work where results are counted in public and shared with partners. Your colleagues and your friends end up as one circle, and your income arrives in surges that you spend on them as fast as it comes. You build more than you keep, and it rarely troubles you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Rival lives inside your Hour Gate: what you build in later life you will share, and sometimes have to defend. Your later life stays loud and full, with children or younger relatives or someone you train arguing with you and for you. Because you value being matched more than being obeyed, you are drawn to the bold ones, and you give them more than you promised yourself. You share most of what you build late, and you hold on to your part only where you fixed its size early.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grew up sharing everything with family.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You treat family as people with a natural claim on your time, your space and your money. Because sharing was how your first home held together, refusing a relative feels like disloyalty to you. You give without fuss, and you resent it quietly when the giving is taken for granted.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: The money and the clothes and the space were all shared in your first home, and a sibling or cousin was never far from what was yours. Growing up you gave without being asked, and you could tell exactly who had taken what.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Family seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your energy has gone into work and friends more than into family, and you have seen less of your relatives than you meant to.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: The people after you take their idea of independence from you, and from your late forties they watch how you manage more closely than they say. You teach them most by example, and the few words you add mean more to them than you expect.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you will push against you and fight for you. You will find those years warmer and riskier than most people's, and you will be happiest in them when you have kept your own keys.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2001 to 2010
sections.text: Order and good manners shaped your home in those years, and everyone knew their place and their duties. You earned respect in your family by keeping its rules, and you felt secure inside them.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2021 to 2030 · now
sections.text: Family care comes with conditions in these years, and help arrives with a say in your choices. You hold steady by keeping a way of your own without a quarrel, and the bond survives the distance you need.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2051 to 2060
sections.text: Pride runs through your family in these years, and each person insists on doing things their own way. The quarrels shrink once everyone has a clear part, and you come through by doing yours without keeping score.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Steward year
sections.text: Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, and you spend more of your time and money on people beyond your own home.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You are paid to make things better.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are best in jobs where improving things is the work itself, editing or design or reform of some kind. Because a weak plan is plain to you before anyone asks, you correct work that was never yours to correct. Your value at work grows with every process you improve, and you are known as the colleague who will not let poor work pass.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn. In you the two never pull apart, and you rarely have to choose between your talent and your training.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Older people at work have backed you since your late teens, vouched for you or quietly put your name forward. You have collected qualifications and references in those years that still carry weight wherever you apply, and you have needed to push less than most.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: In class, in teams and in your first jobs you have been the one who points out what could be better. You have clashed with at least one boss over it, and you have also been the person they sent for when something needed fixing.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your influence grows as titles start to matter less, and people begin to repeat what you say. Younger people carry your methods into their own work, and you hear your own style in the way they argue with you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2002 to 2011
sections.text: Unusual work suited you in those years, the kind that needs odd knowledge and long hours alone. You became good at something few others understood, and it earned you respect before it earned you anything else.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Your work in those years was a contest, and you did best when someone else wanted the same result. You were sharpest with a rival close by, and that drive got you further than talent alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Authority pushes back on you in these years, and a frank remark costs more than it used to. Work that is yours alone carries you through, and you do better outside a strict chain of command.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Ambition softens in these years, and the easy option keeps winning in your work. The value of what you make keeps you going, and you move forward each time a deadline gives you a reason to finish.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Routine tightens around your work in these years, and caution keeps you from moves that would pay more. Your reliability keeps you valued, and you find a better fit once someone else sees what you are worth.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Steward year
sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Your work turns toward study and specialist skill this year, and you learn more out of sight than you earn in plain view.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Sage stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are seen as the calm one who knows things. The people above you at work take you seriously early, because you have the facts and a steady manner. Their trust moves your career through reputation and study more than through pushing, and you learn whatever they are willing to teach. Your friends come to you with their problems for the same reason. You give a great deal of calm away, and you are rarely the one anyone thinks to look after.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years run on seeing how everything could be better. You spot the better version of a plan, a process or a piece of work almost at once, and the weaker version nags at you for days. Because an unfixed flaw weighs on you more than hard work does, you keep improving things long after others call them finished, and you are still thinking about them at night. Managers find you tiring and colleagues find you useful, and you are proud of being both.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later years are when people hear you most clearly. In later life you do your boldest work, at a point when most people expect you to ease off. Because saying the true thing matters more to you than a title, you speak more freely each year, and some who hold rank resent it. You keep changing while there is something new to learn. You pass your talent to the people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, along with your dislike of being told what to do.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grew up level with the people around you.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You treat your family as equals, present and practical and never fussy. Because closeness when you were small came from standing side by side, you show tenderness late and mostly through what you do. You turn up to fix a family problem before anyone asks, and you rarely say what you feel while you do it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and promises kept, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: In your first home a sibling or a cousin stood beside you as an equal, and the two of you looked after each other. You learned to settle things between yourselves, and the adults were the last to hear about them.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Family seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your energy has gone into work and friends more than into family, and you have seen less of your relatives than you meant to.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you seek you out for talk they cannot get anywhere else. You become the one in your family whose opinion is asked for, and you give it with more warmth than you once did.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: Your family runs on shared effort in these ten years, and each person at home carries a fair part. You do your share before anyone asks, and relatives come to you as one equal to another.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Indulgence runs the household in these years, with treats, late meals and little order. You get through on the warmth itself, and you wear yourself out less as your family learns to look after itself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Keeping the household in order weighs on you in these years, and you carry more of it than your share. The order you built keeps you going, and you pass some of the load over once your family sees it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Steward year
sections.text: Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, and you spend more of your time and money on people beyond your own home.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept. You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Twin lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years you learned to rely on yourself. Your first home expected you to manage, and you were trusted with your own problems before most children are. Because you were trusted young, you came to trust yourself before anyone else, and you worked out much of what you know without asking. The habit makes it hard for you to let people in, at home or anywhere, and you accept help only after you have tried it alone.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Virtuoso inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Virtuoso lives inside your Hour Gate: your later life stays full of ideas, opinions and people who argue back. In later life you keep making things and saying what you think, and you look for younger people who will take you on. Because being heard has always kept you well, the ones who stand up to you become your favourites, whether they are children or younger relatives or someone you train. Your family gets your sharpest wit and your newest plans, and you stay closest to the ones who also get your warmth.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grow from trusting yourself first.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Every skill you have began with deciding that you could do it. Because you learned early to depend on yourself, nobody can push you into learning, and you take to a teacher only once you have chosen them. You pick things up faster with one other person learning beside you, and you let few people that close.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, you grow most through the years that weigh on you, and you have left every heavy stretch more skilled than you entered it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You taught yourself things as a child that the adults around you had not shown you, and you kept quiet about how hard it was. By the time you were grown you had a stubborn way of learning, on your own terms and at your own pace.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have grown through work, friends and family more than through any plan to improve yourself, and change has come to you by circumstance.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Saying out loud what you used to keep to yourself becomes your way of growing from your late forties, and people who once called you difficult start calling you wise. You stay sharp in these years while something in your life is new, and you go looking for it when nothing is.

sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2002 to 2011
sections.text: Unconventional paths taught you most in those years, a strange course, a self-taught skill or a mentor outside the usual. You developed in your own direction, and the difference became your strength.

sections.text: Self-reliance pays in these ten years. You teach yourself what you need and find equals to train beside, and you come out of the decade more capable on your own terms.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You do your best work under real pressure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You pick the job with the highest stakes and the tightest deadlines, and you are at your sharpest when it is going badly for everyone else. Because pressure is how you prove yourself to yourself, calm work leaves you flat and restless. What you build fastest is respect, and what you lose first is rest.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also keep correcting the very structures you climb, and you do your brightest work wherever the rules are loosest.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Bosses have either backed you fully or tried to slow you down since your late teens, and few have stayed neutral about you. You have done your best work for the ones who believed in you, and you have outlasted most of the ones who did not.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · now
sections.text: A calm post has left you uneasy since your late teens, as if you had not earned your place, and you have asked for the hard assignment instead. Each crisis you took on left you more trusted, and at least once you turned down an easier job with better hours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Virtuoso at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your influence grows as titles start to matter less, and people begin to repeat what you say. Younger people carry your methods into their own work, and you hear your own style in the way they argue with you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2002 to 2011
sections.text: Comfort dulled your drive at work in those years, and easy work held you longer than it should have. You were well liked and under-stretched, and the skill you kept practising for pleasure is what kept you going.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Your work in those years was a contest, and you did best when someone else wanted the same result. You were sharpest with a rival close by, and that drive got you further than talent alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Unusual knowledge brings you work in these years, through research, advice or technical skill. People come to you for what others do not know, and your name grows inside a small field.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Hierarchy presses on your work in these ten years, and each new duty adds to rules that are already strict. Your good name holds throughout, and what carries you is the part of the work you shape yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Demands pile up in your work through these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing holds through the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

You have rarely rested before a job was finished, and your sleep and your energy are what that pace has cost you.

sections.text: Your body carries the cost of your pace.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You run on adrenaline through long weeks and notice the tiredness only when the pressure lifts. Because effort is where you feel most like yourself, you push through poor sleep as if it were part of the job. Your energy is deep, and you spend it faster than you replace it.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Through your first working years your body kept pace with demands that stopped most people around you. A hard season ended more than once with you worn out for weeks, and you recovered fully each time you gave yourself real rest.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: From your late forties your health rests on routine, and a steady week keeps you fitter than most people your age. Days with no shape drain your energy and ordered ones bring it back, and you feel the difference within a week.

sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2002 to 2011
sections.text: Rich food, late nights and easy evenings piled up in those years, and your energy dropped as the habits grew. A plain daily routine brought you back, and you felt the change within weeks.

sections.text: You grow in long quiet stretches that look like standing still, and then you change all at once. Because you change on the inside first, the people around you often underrate where you are, and you let them. You are further along than anyone watching would guess.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes through the people close to you.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You find money through other people, in a tip from a friend or a side venture with someone close. Because your openings arrive through people you trust, you say yes before you read the terms, and you earn in bursts more than in a steady line. The money you make fastest is the money you hold on to least.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people come to you for what few others know. You become known for a rare kind of knowledge, and people with odd problems come looking for you. Because your insight keeps growing with use, your strongest ideas and your most valued work come after your late forties. The younger people who seek you out, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn from you what no course offered them. You are consulted far more than you are kept company, and your method stays unwritten for longer than it should.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your circle is full of rivals you respect.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Most of your friends come from work, and many of them started as people you competed against. Because you respect anyone who can beat you, your closest bond at work is with a former rival. You lose friends over contests more easily than most people, and you keep the ones who competed fairly.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were the one others looked to in a fight or a dare, and you did not give way easily. Your friends by your teens were either as tough as you or kept at a distance, and you learned diplomacy slowly.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: From your late teens you have made friends through competition, in teams and courses and workplaces where everyone was ranked. More than once a friendship ended when you won, and you have kept the rival who took a loss well.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Social seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: During those years you held yourself apart from most groups, sure that few people matched your standard. Your circle grew smaller than it had been, and the one or two friends who stayed were enough to carry you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: In company you were the lively one in those years, quick with a joke and a sharp opinion. People sought you out for your wit, and you enjoyed being heard.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2048 to 2057
sections.text: You hold standing among friends in these years, and people ask your opinion before they decide. You are the steady one in your circle, and you take the part seriously.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations shape your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

Your early life carried pressure that others could see, a demanding home or a tough school or a name you had to defend. Because you were tested young and in public, people learned to respect you early, and authority came to you sooner than to your friends. That start made you hard to push around, and you still take the measure of every new group or job before you settle into it.

sections.text: The Rival stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work people see your nerve before anything else. You volunteer whenever there is a contest to enter, and the colleague who ranks first is the one you watch. Because winning in the open is how you prove your worth, you climb quickest where results are ranked and stall where credit is pooled. You make friends and allies through the same contests, and you lose some of them as quickly as you made them. Your worst setbacks have come through bets you shared with someone else.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. Two sit in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money ends up settled and secure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You keep reserves for every possible need, and a full account calms you more than any purchase. Because security is what you work for, you spend on others easily and on yourself with reluctance. You have more comfort available than you let yourself use.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put work, study and friends before money, and your income has stayed below what you could earn.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2046 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you start bringing you their plans and asking for support. You spend more on other people's ventures in these years than on your own comfort, and you are glad of most of it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2046 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your money stays steady from your late forties while others worry, and your plans for it land where you intend. You find in these years that some of what you saved is meant for your own pleasure, and you learn to use it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2037 to 2046
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Rival stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people see your nerve and ask you to back them. Your later years stay bold and public, and you keep taking risks long after people your age have stopped. Because being in the contest keeps you feeling alive, you say yes to children or younger relatives or someone you train more than you planned, and their ventures keep you learning. You find real joy in some of that backing, and you lose part of what you give because you say yes before you ask what it is for.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years sits a quiet habit of keeping everything provided for. In later life you want things settled, with savings kept, care arranged and nothing left to chance. Because providing is how you love, you make arrangements for others long before they are needed, and you keep your own sleep and meals in the same good order. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn thrift by watching you. Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Five seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your home runs well, and everyone leans on it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You keep your household running, the cupboards full and the bills paid before they are due. Because a well kept home is how you show love, you feel uneasy when things at home are left undone. Your family feels safe without knowing how much you do, and you rarely tell them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: An older relative in your first home made a point of standing on their own, and you copied it before you understood it. You asked for less with each year you grew, and the adults around you praised you for it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: In your first home you carried a weight few people saw, a strict rule or a hard stretch or a worry beyond your age. By your teens you were the steady one in your family, and you kept your own needs to yourself.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Family seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your energy has gone into work and friends more than into family, and you have seen less of your relatives than you meant to.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2033 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your home becomes the steady point for your whole family from your mid-thirties, the place relatives come to when life is hard. You give these years to keeping it well, and the order you keep outlasts every crisis that passes through.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2046 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your family gathers around what you give, the meals and the gifts and the time. Younger people grow easy and generous around you, and you see the best of yourself in them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2046 · inside · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you gather at your table more each year. The care you have given starts to come back to you in these years, and you are looked after by those you once fed.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Keeping the household in order weighs on you in these years, and you carry more of it than your share. The order you built keeps you going, and you pass some of the load over once your family sees it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2048 to 2057
sections.text: Obligations at home pile up in these years, with duties to the people who rely on you and a family name to protect. You meet them faithfully, and you guard a part of your life that belongs to you alone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2068 to 2077
sections.text: Family support reaches you in these ten years, as advice, practical help or a place to come back to. You receive more care than you expected, and you return it to the people who gave it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Twin stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your family raised you to stand on your own. As a child you were noticed for being capable, and help at home was something you earned. Because managing alone won you approval early, people still meet that capable face first, and friends trust you to carry your share. Asking your family or anyone else for something has stayed the hardest thing you do, and you go without more often than the people around you guess.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The General inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The General lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years was a weight you carried quietly. Your first home asked a lot of you as a child, and you gave it more strength than anyone thought to ask about. Because you had to be strong early, you learned to stay calm in a crisis and uneasy when life goes easy. The same strength left a habit of carrying everything alone, and you still keep your tiredness to yourself. Each hard stretch since has added to what you can carry, and you are steadier for it.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life is built on steady, practical care. You love by providing, with the bills paid and food in the house on ordinary days. Because steadiness is how you feel safe, you want a partner who values upkeep as much as you do. The cost comes when care turns into chores and the warmth goes quiet. The people you love come to rely on the calm home you keep, and you are proudest of that.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later years are known for what you make and give. In later life people see you cooking, mending or teaching for others, and children or younger relatives or someone you train pick up your skills along with your generosity. Because being useful puts you at ease, you keep making things for the pleasure of it and passing on what your hands know. Comfort that asks nothing of you is the one thing that slows your work, and you notice it in the weeks with no one to make anything for.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Hour Gate: your later life settles into good food, deep sleep and people who keep coming back. In later life you get to enjoy the comfort you have worked for, and your home fills with younger people and long friendships. Because care has always meant a good meal and a warm bed to you, you keep feeding whoever comes, whether they are children or younger relatives or someone you train. Ease is both the reward of those years and their one risk, and you stay well for as long as your days keep a rhythm.

You pass your talent to the people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, along with your dislike of being told what to do.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money grows quietly from early habits.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You save without thinking about it, a little from everything, and spending without a reason feels wrong to you. Because careful habits were normal in your first home, you build wealth slowly and steadily, and few people notice until it is large. You enjoy keeping money more than spending it, and a big purchase stays on your mind for weeks.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You kept coins and small earnings longer than your friends did as a child, and nobody had to tell you to. You learned early that money kept quietly was money that stayed, and you have never lost the habit.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put work, study and friends before money, and your income has stayed below what you could earn.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2047 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties chances to earn keep arriving, through new projects and through people a generation younger who want you involved. You give a great deal in these years, and your affairs stay clear only where you have put the details in writing.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2002 to 2011
sections.text: Money went out on friends in those years, lent to them or spent keeping up with them. You learned what generosity costs, and you got through on work you could do on your own.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: You turn steady work into something you own in these ten years, a home or savings or a share in something lasting. You keep more of what you earn than in any decade before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2072 to 2081
sections.text: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a lucky move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your first years lay a careful home where nothing was wasted. You took in your family's habits with money before you could name them, and they still shape how you feel about spending. Because thrift felt like safety when you were small, you save quietly and early, and your money grows in ways other people mistake for luck. Your relatives remain the people you turn to first, and they turn to you. Under the calm sits a small worry about running short, and you carry it even in good years.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures. In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: You absorbed your family's rules early.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: The expectations you grew up with stay with you, and you feel uneasy when a family duty goes undone. Because approval at home came through doing things right, you check yourself against what your elders would think. Your bond with your family is strong and dutiful, and you feel its pull long after you have left home.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your first home ran on care and clear rules, kept by a parent or older relative who held everyone to a high standard. By your teens you had their sense of right and wrong, and people outside the family noticed it in you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You knew the rules of your first home without being told, and you rarely needed correcting. By your teens you had taken on an older relative's standards as your own, and you held yourself to them strictly.

sections.head: GAP ROW

sections.text: Since sixteen your energy has gone into work and friends more than into family, and you have seen less of your relatives than you meant to.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: From your late forties the people after you return the care you once gave them, in visits and help you did not ask for. You become the calm centre of a close family in these years, and you take their help without keeping score.

sections.text: Home was warm in those years, full of meals and easy evenings with the people you lived with. You were the one who brought comfort to others, and your family loved you for it.

You still measure yourself by the standards you learned at home, and you do best wherever the next step is written down.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Sage stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life you are seen as the one who teaches and protects. Most of your growth in later life comes through teaching, and it sorts out your own thinking as much as anyone's. Your family treats you as the person to call when something goes wrong. sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years is a quiet store of care, given back. In later life help reaches you anyway, as care from children or younger relatives or someone you trained, and you learn to take it slowly. Your days settle into steady routines of reading, rest and good company, and your mind stays clear on them. You feel smallest in the weeks when nobody needs anything from you, and you rarely say so.

sections.text: You learn steadily, and it never stops.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you rarely feel finished. You know far more than you claim to.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also learn best when you can show what you learn, and you turn every course you finish into something you can say out loud. In you the two never pull apart, and you rarely have to choose between your talent and your training.

Ease is both the reward of those years and their one risk, and you stay well for as long as your days keep a rhythm.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money finds new openings late in life.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You notice a chance to earn where others see an ending, a late venture or a deal offered by someone younger. Because new money excites you more than kept money, you give generously and write down too little of it. Your plans live in your head far longer than they live on paper.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put work, study and friends before money, and your income has stayed below what you could earn.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2050 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties chances to earn keep arriving, through new projects and through people a generation younger who want you involved. You give a great deal in these years, and your affairs stay clear only where you have put the details in writing.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a lucky move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2072 to 2081
sections.text: You turn steady work into something you own in these ten years, a home or savings or a share in something lasting. You keep more of what you earn than in any decade before it.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures. In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Mind in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your mind has always worked at an angle.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You come at problems from an unexpected direction, and people notice the answer before they understand the route. Because your mind took its own path from the start, you get bored by the obvious approach and drift toward the strange one. Your way of thinking is the first thing people remember about you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you learned in a way teachers struggled to mark, reaching the right answer by a route nobody had taught. By your teens you were known for it, as the clever one or the odd one, and you were both.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Mind seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have learned by doing more than by study, and your thinking has served your work and friendships more than any subject of its own.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Mind seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2006 to 2015
sections.text: You turned inward in those years, into subjects few people around you shared. You spent long stretches alone with your thinking, and you came out of it with work that still feels like the most important you have done.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2016 to 2025
sections.text: Comfort in what you already knew held you in those years, and new ideas felt like a threat to it. You read and studied more than you acted, and the depth of what you had learned is what kept you going.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2076 to 2085
sections.text: You turn your thinking outward in these years, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against received ideas this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · a Sage year
sections.text: Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Odd, specialist subjects pull at your thinking this year, and you study alone what few people around you would think to ask about.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: as a child you were seen as watchful, deep and a little apart. Adults noticed early that you learned differently from other children, and some of them were unsure what to make of it. Because you took in the world on your own terms, teachers found you older than your years and other children found you hard to read. That early difference still shapes how people see you, thoughtful and selective and slow to open up. You let a few friends close in place of a crowd, and you have not regretted the trade.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Mind in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You see further in later life, and faster.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You see the shape of a problem before anyone has finished describing it to you. Because your judgement rests on patterns you have gathered for years, you can name the answer long before you can show the working, and people find that hard to follow. You rarely explain how you got there, and some people stop asking.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Mind seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have learned by doing more than by study, and your thinking has served your work and friendships more than any subject of its own.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2051 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your mind keeps sharpening, and you take on questions you once put aside. You do some of your best thinking in these years, and it reaches further once someone younger helps you put it into words.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2010 to 2019
sections.text: Ideas came fast in those years, and you spoke them aloud with confidence. You were quicker than the people around you, and you enjoyed proving it in argument.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2070 to 2079
sections.text: You study more than you act in these years, and your thinking turns cautious. Work that puts what you know to use carries you through, and you trust your own ideas again once you see them working.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against received ideas this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life people come to you for what few others know. You become known for a rare kind of knowledge, and people with odd problems come looking for you. Because your insight keeps growing with use, your strongest ideas and your most valued work come after your late forties. The younger people who seek you out, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn from you what no course offered them. You are consulted far more than you are kept company, and your method stays unwritten for longer than it should.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Growth in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You keep learning what few people bother to learn.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: With each decade you go deeper into rare subjects, the overlooked field or the old method nobody teaches. Because the unusual is what holds your interest, you grow faster on your own than in any class, and you find most courses too slow. You buy the out-of-print book and write to the one person still working on the question.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, you grow most through the years that weigh on you, and you have left every heavy stretch more skilled than you entered it.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have grown through work, friends and family more than through any plan to improve yourself, and change has come to you by circumstance.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2051 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: You grow from your late forties by mastering one rare thing completely. You put what you learn into a form others can use, a written method or a body of work, and you see it travel further than you do.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2060 to 2069
sections.text: You grow fastest in these years through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You come out of the decade stronger in the places that used to hold you back.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.sub: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: People take to you quickly, and in numbers.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You make friends fast, and a new group accepts you within an evening. Because charm was your family's way with people, you collect many allies and only a few who would stay through trouble. You know the difference between the two, and you feel it most in a hard year when the crowd thins.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were popular with other children and with adults, and you were invited to more than your share. By the time you were grown you had a wide circle and one or two close friends who mattered far more, and you knew which were which.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Social seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put study, work and family before friendship, and your circle has stayed smaller than the people around you expected.

sections.head: NOTE
sections.text: Your later gates hold no Social seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2007 to 2016
sections.text: Respect came to you in those years through how you conducted yourself among others. People saw you as fair and dependable, and you were asked to lead more than once.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2037 to 2046
sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2047 to 2056
sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2067 to 2076
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend often.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2077 to 2086
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and friends of friends, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Rival stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: you grew up in a bold family where money moved fast. People who knew your first home remember its nerve and its charm, the way it won over a crowded table. Because boldness was praised at home, people warm to you quickly, and you act while others are still deciding. You learned to spend as fast as you earn, much of it on friends, and you feel uneasy holding on to money for long.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Health in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your health in later life rests on gentle rhythm.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You stay well on regular meals, unhurried walks and early nights, and you sleep badly the week the rhythm breaks. Because ease restores you, you let the ease run on past the point it helps you, until days with no effort leave you flat and low on energy. You feel best in a week that holds a small challenge.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your body has come second to work and study, and you have been spending the reserve your childhood gave you.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2052 · inside · coming
sections.text: Your body does well from your late forties on gentle habits and the company of people who look after you. You hold your strength in these years through one demanding thing each week, and you feel the difference whenever you let it go.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2029 to 2038
sections.text: You ease into your body in these years, with better appetite and better sleep and more pleasure in ordinary days. You enjoy your health in this decade more than in the one before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2069 to 2078
sections.text: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2079 to 2088
sections.text: Too much rest dulls you in these years, and comfortable days leave your energy low. What carries you is regular movement and a reason to get up early, and you feel better each time you have one.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years is a quiet store of care, given back. Accepting help feels strange to you, because for most of your life you have done the looking after. In later life help reaches you anyway, as care from children or younger relatives or someone you trained, and you learn to take it slowly. Your days settle into steady routines of reading, rest and good company, and your mind stays clear on them. You feel smallest in the weeks when nobody needs anything from you, and you rarely say so.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Social in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your reputation keeps rising, decade by decade.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are the person people ask to chair the meeting or hold the keys or settle the dispute. Because you take duty seriously, you say yes to roles others avoid, and your circle trusts you more each year. Your friendships carry a little formality, and you find it hard to let others see you off duty.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Social seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put study, work and family before friendship, and your circle has stayed smaller than the people around you expected.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2052 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Past your late forties your community keeps giving you positions of trust, a committee or a board or a role as the steady voice. You are honoured more in these years than in your busiest working ones, and you choose carefully which causes get your name.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2011 to 2020
sections.text: Acquaintances crowded those years, and you knew people in many places without letting many of them close. One old friend who stayed kept you steady, and you confided in that friend more than in anyone new.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2021 to 2030 · now
sections.text: Bluntness strains your friendships in these years, and some people take offence at what you meant as wit. The friends who stay value your candour, and you find them worth more than a wide circle.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2041 to 2050
sections.text: Rivalry turns friendly in these years, and people who compete with you end up on your side. You keep a busy circle through the decade, one where you give and receive in fair measure.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2051 to 2060
sections.text: Your friends in these ten years are equals, people with their own lives and their own strength. Your circle stays small and solid, and you trust it more than any crowd.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations shape your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life your standing and your standards are what people see. Your judgement is still wanted long after a job has ended, and the requests grow with each decade. Because doing things properly is how you earn your place, you take on roles of trust in later life and fill them with care. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, measure themselves against your example. In your circle and at home your name is one people rely on, and you keep it in good order.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your mind stays quick and restless with every decade.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You keep your mind busy with projects and opinions, and an empty week wears you down faster than a hard one. Since an idea feels finished to you only once it has been argued, you go looking for a debate when none comes to you. Your thinking stays quick while it has work, and you feel the loss within days when it has none.

sections.head: GAP ROW

sections.text: Since sixteen you have learned by doing more than by study, and your thinking has served your work and friendships more than any subject of its own.

sections.text: Your thinking gets bolder past your late forties, and you say plainly what you held back in earlier years. An idea that grips you keeps you up at night, and you sleep well again once you have said it out loud.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2017 to 2026 · now
sections.text: Learning comes easily in these years, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, and you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2027 to 2036
sections.text: Your intuition is sharp in these ten years, and unusual ideas find a use. You think in ways few others do, and people come to you for the angle they missed.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 2057 to 2066
sections.text: You argue with more of what you are told in these years, and every rule you meet feels like a challenge. One piece of work big enough to take all that argument carries you through, and you are calmest on the days you finish something.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a Virtuoso year

Because being heard has always kept you well, the ones who stand up to you become your favourites, whether they are children or younger relatives or someone you train. Your family gets your sharpest wit and your newest plans, and you stay closest to the ones who also get your warmth.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your family feels your protection first.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You look after your family by making sure they are safe, the arrangements firm and the risks dealt with before anyone else sees them. Because care for you means strength, you find it easier to fix a problem than to say a tender thing. Your family knows they are covered, and they wait longer to hear that they are loved.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: An older relative in your first home made a point of standing on their own, and you copied it before you understood it. You asked for less with each year you grew, and the adults around you praised you for it.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: In your first home a sibling or a cousin stood beside you as an equal, and the two of you looked after each other. You learned to settle things between yourselves, and the adults were the last to hear about them.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: The people after you have measured themselves against you since your late forties. They took your standards seriously, and you saw at least once that a sharp word from you stayed with them for years.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The General inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: The people after you have leaned on your strength in hard moments since your late forties. You sorted out the problem before you asked how they felt, and you saw them keep the few kind words you did say for years.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 1963 to 1972
sections.text: Family duty weighed on you in those years, and you met expectations that left you little say. You did what was asked of you well, and you came out of it with the respect it earned you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 1983 to 1992
sections.text: Care surrounded you in those years, from family who put your needs first and helped without being asked. You felt protected, and that security gave you the nerve to take on more than before.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1993 to 2002
sections.text: Those years made you an equal in your family, with a voice as strong as anyone's. You stood on your own feet among your relatives, and they treated your word as worth the same as theirs.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: During those years you gave your family more comfort than they asked for, and some of them came to expect it. You spoiled the people closest to you, and you got your own ease back once others began to care for you in turn.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Sage year
sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2028 · a Twin year
sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You do your best work under real pressure.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You pick the job with the highest stakes and the tightest deadlines, and you are at your sharpest when it is going badly for everyone else. Because pressure is how you prove yourself to yourself, calm work leaves you flat and restless. What you build fastest is respect, and what you lose first is rest.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your reputation at work has grown out of hard moments since your late teens, the emergency handled or the project rescued. You were promoted at least once for the steadiness you showed in a bad week.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: A calm post has left you uneasy since your late teens, as if you had not earned your place, and you have asked for the hard assignment instead. Each crisis you took on left you more trusted, and at least once you turned down an easier job with better hours.
