sections.text: The Sage holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years are carried by steady learning. You keep studying long after the people around you have stopped, and what you know sits under everything you do. Because learning is how you feel safe, you prepare thoroughly for every step, and you wait to feel ready before you put yourself forward at work. Your ability has outrun your confidence for years, and the people who taught you saw it before you did. You grow at your own careful pace, and you are usually the last to see how far you have come.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures. In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Twin lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years rest on a few people who treat you as their equal. In later life you keep company only where you are met level, with old friends who became family and with children or younger relatives or someone you train who speak to you as equals. Because dignity matters more to you than comfort, you turn down help that comes with pity. You keep learning through the few people who still argue with you. The circle gets smaller as the decades pass, and you lean on the ones who remain more than you admit.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: One seat rules Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money finds new openings late in life.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You notice a chance to earn where others see an ending, a late venture or a deal offered by someone younger. Because new money excites you more than kept money, you give generously and write down too little of it. Your plans live in your head far longer than they live on paper.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Money has reached you through new ventures and unexpected offers since your late forties, at least once from a direction you had stopped watching. You have given a good share of it away, more than once without noting to whom.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2019 to 2028 · now
sections.text: You turn steady work into something you own in these ten years, a home or savings or a share in something lasting. You keep more of what you earn than in any decade before it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2029 to 2038
sections.text: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a lucky move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your family looks after you, and you let it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are cared for by younger people more than you expected, with visits and help and small kindnesses. Because you are used to being the one who gives, you wave off help you need, and it hurts the people offering. What you want from your family now is company more than help.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: An older relative in your first home, a parent or someone who stood in for one, spent widely and drew people around them. Growing up you learned both the warmth of that generosity and what it cost the household.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: A parent or an older relative looked after you closely when you were small, and you came to rely on their calm. By your teens you expected the world to treat you with the same care, and mostly it did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: You have become the relative who hosts since your late forties, the one whose home younger people head for at holidays. The people after you have picked up your habits of giving, and you see yourself in how they treat their own guests.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Little acts of care have come to you unasked since your late forties, a lift or a meal or a call from younger people. You have found them harder to accept than to give, and you have learned to say yes more often.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1978 to 1987
sections.text: Home was warm in those years, full of meals and easy evenings with the people you lived with. You were the one who brought comfort to others, and your family loved you for it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Meals, chores and repairs ran smoothly at home in those years because you saw to them. Your family grew used to your steadiness, and you took pride in it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Your household opened outward in those years, through travel, new relatives or friends who became family. You gave generously to everyone at home, and the house was busier for it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: Order and good manners shaped your home in those years, and everyone knew their place and their duties. You earned respect in your family by keeping its rules, and you felt secure inside them.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Family care comes with conditions in these years, and help arrives with a say in your choices. You hold steady by keeping a way of your own without a quarrel, and the bond survives the distance you need.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home spent openly on people and on chances. You grew up in a family that spent on guests, gifts and new plans, and everyone who visited could see it. Because money moved freely in the house you grew up in, you learned to spot a chance quickly and to hold cash loosely. That ease with risk has served you well, and you still give faster than you keep.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was real care, steady enough to trust. Someone in your first home gave you decent, patient care, and the ease it gave you became the way you meet the world. Because care reached you early, you trust people first, and you find the protective ones quickly. The same safety made leaving it hard, and you have stayed in comfortable places longer than they helped you grow. You still sleep and eat better after a hard season once you are back with the people who love you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later years are known for what you make and give. In later life people see you cooking, mending or teaching for others, and children or younger relatives or someone you train pick up your skills along with your generosity. Because being useful puts you at ease, you keep making things for the pleasure of it and passing on what your hands know. Comfort that asks nothing of you is the one thing that slows your work, and you notice it in the weeks with no one to make anything for.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years is a quiet store of care, given back. Accepting help feels strange to you, because for most of your life you have done the looking after. In later life help reaches you anyway, as care from children or younger relatives or someone you trained, and you learn to take it slowly. Your days settle into steady routines of reading, rest and good company, and your mind stays clear on them. You feel smallest in the weeks when nobody needs anything from you, and you rarely say so.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your career rises on what you have studied.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are trusted at work because you know your subject properly, and people check their facts with you. Because depth matters more to you than visibility, you leave the self-promotion to others, and promotion reaches you later than it should. Your standing grows slowly and holds when louder careers fall away.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You are also paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Since your late teens you have been the one handed the job nobody else would finish alone. You have changed teams or roles at least once because someone else took the credit for your work.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your progress at work since your late teens has come through what you studied, each qualification earned before you asked for the next step. At least once someone senior put your name forward before you felt ready, and you have proved them right.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your work has turned since your late forties toward teaching, hosting or finishing projects you had put off for years. Some of what you have made in this stretch has been better received than anything from your busier decades, and you have been surprised by it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 1968 to 1977
sections.text: Talent made your name in those years, through work that broke with how things were usually done. You stood out for being different, and the people who chose you wanted exactly that.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1978 to 1987
sections.text: Work came easily in those years, especially work that let you make things or please people. You did your best at a relaxed pace, and others valued what you produced.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Steady work rewarded you in those years, and your record stayed clean. You became known as the person who delivers on time, and the reputation followed you into later work.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: Recognition came the proper way in those years, through good work noticed by the right people. You earned a place you could be proud of, and you carried the responsibility well.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: You take on hard assignments and real pressure in these years, and you rise because of them. You come out of the decade with more authority than you went in with.

sections.sub: 2026 · a Virtuoso year

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Two seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your health in later life rests on gentle rhythm.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You stay well on regular meals, unhurried walks and early nights, and you sleep badly the week the rhythm breaks. Because ease restores you, you let the ease run on past the point it helps you, until days with no effort leave you flat and low on energy. You feel best in a week that holds a small challenge.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: Whenever you were tired or run down as a child, someone was there with a meal and an early night, and you were yourself again within days. By your teens you had a steady energy the adults around you counted on, and you have kept much of it since.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Your sleep has come more easily since your late forties, and your days have found a steadier pace. You have also gone through a stretch of too much rest, and your energy came back once something asked more of you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1978 to 1987
sections.text: Your appetite and sleep were good in those years, and ordinary pleasures kept you well. You ate with enjoyment and moved without strain, and you felt at ease in your own body.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Too much rest dulls you in these years, and comfortable days leave your energy low. What carries you is regular movement and a reason to get up early, and you feel better each time you have one.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.text: You learn steadily, and it never stops.

sections.text: Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you rarely feel finished. You know far more than you claim to.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your later family is a few people who understand your silences.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You keep family life quiet and close, with a small number of people who know when to leave you be. Because your inner life matters more to you than a full house, you see your relatives less than they would like, and you love them no less for it. You show care by what you teach more than by what you say.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: As a child you knew that money at home was handled carefully and that nothing was spent without a reason. Early on you counted your own money and kept your word the way the household did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Younger people in your family have brought you their problems since your late forties, and you have taken real care over each one. At least once you have protected someone younger at a cost to yourself, and you would do it again.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Your own work has taken up more of your afternoons since your late forties, and you welcome quiet visits most. One of the younger people around you has learned to sit with your silence, and you have trusted that person with more of your thinking than anyone.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1961 to 1970
sections.text: Home was warm in those years, full of meals and easy evenings with the people you lived with. You were the one who brought comfort to others, and your family loved you for it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1981 to 1990
sections.text: In those years you kept your own counsel at home and turned down help you were offered more than once. The distance grew quietly, and what carried you was the one relative who treated you as an equal.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Sage decade · 1991 to 2000
sections.text: Your family sheltered you in those years more than you needed, and the care came with expectations. You kept the peace by doing what was expected, and what carried you was one thing you chose for yourself.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2011 to 2020
sections.text: Order and good manners shaped your home in those years, and everyone knew their place and their duties. You earned respect in your family by keeping its rules, and you felt secure inside them.

sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2031 to 2040
sections.text: Your family life settles in these years around the order you keep, a home that runs well and bills paid on time. You are the one your relatives rely on, and you are glad to be.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your first years lay a careful home where nothing was wasted. You took in your family's habits with money before you could name them, and they still shape how you feel about spending. Because thrift felt like safety when you were small, you save quietly and early, and your money grows in ways other people mistake for luck. Your relatives remain the people you turn to first, and they turn to you. Under the calm sits a small worry about running short, and you carry it even in good years.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Sage stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life you are seen as the one who teaches and protects. Because care and knowledge are what you have to give, you pass them on freely, to children or younger relatives or someone you train. Most of your growth in later life comes through teaching, and it sorts out your own thinking as much as anyone's. Your family treats you as the person to call when something goes wrong. You hear other people's troubles far more often than anyone asks after you, and you feel that on quiet evenings.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Alchemist inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Alchemist lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years turn inward, toward study and a quiet you choose. Past your late forties your days gather around a few deep interests and a household that respects a closed door. Because you trust what you have worked out alone, your understanding gets clearer with each decade, and you grow by narrowing your attention. sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your money comes in strong seasons and quiet ones.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You earn in bursts, a run of good months and a quiet stretch after. Because each good season makes you sure of the next, you spend the winnings on a new chance before you have kept any. You are richer in the middle of each lucky stretch than after it.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, what you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play. In you the gap is short, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: You kept coins and small earnings longer than your friends did as a child, and nobody had to tell you to. You learned early that money kept quietly was money that stayed, and you have never lost the habit.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: What you have earned since your late teens has followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. At least once you have lost the gains of a good year by chasing a better one, and you have learned how your own luck runs.

sections.text: Since your late forties your accounts have settled, the debts cleared and the savings finally visible. You became the one in your family with enough, and you have quietly paid for more than you mention.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your money since your late forties has gone into travel, new projects and the plans of younger people more than into reserves. You have earned well from at least one late venture, and you have spent a good part of it on getting people together.

sections.text: Expenses felt heavy in those years, and you counted money long after there was enough. Your savings grew while your pleasure shrank, and you came through on the security that careful habit built.

sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2003 to 2012
sections.text: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.

sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Four seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your friends bring you their troubles.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You are the friend people confide in, the calm one who listens and gives sound advice. Because being trusted feels like a kind of care to you, you rarely say no, and your evenings fill with other people's problems. You know more about your friends' lives than they know about yours.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Rival at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were popular with other children and with adults, and you were invited to more than your share. By the time you were grown you had a wide circle and one or two close friends who mattered far more, and you knew which were which.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Friends and colleagues have brought you their crises since your late teens, and several of your closest friendships began with someone else's bad news. You have kept more confidences than you can count, and people still repeat what you told them years ago.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · lived
sections.text: Through your Home Chapter your closest friendships have been between equals, people who did not need you to rescue them. You gave less time to the friends who wanted looking after, and you kept the level ones.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your name has carried weight in your circle since your late forties, and groups you once simply belonged to have put you in charge. You gained respect that outlasted any title, and you found yourself consulted on matters well outside your old work.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1966 to 1975
sections.text: During those years you held yourself apart from most groups, sure that few people matched your standard. Your circle grew smaller than it had been, and the one or two friends who stayed were enough to carry you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Rival decade · 1976 to 1985
sections.text: Friendship and contest mixed in those years, and more than once a friend took credit or a prize you had earned. You got through on the company itself, and you learned to tell an ally from a competitor.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Virtuoso decade · 1996 to 2005
sections.text: Things you said aloud cost you friends in those years, and more than one group left you out afterwards. You kept the people who liked your honesty, and those few saw you through.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2006 to 2015
sections.text: Your circle spread wide in those years, through travel, work and friends of friends. You met people easily everywhere you went, and several of them opened doors for you.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2036 to 2045
sections.text: You hold standing among friends in these years, and people ask your opinion before they decide. You are the steady one in your circle, and you take the part seriously.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations shape your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2030 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2031 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year over the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2033 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2034 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and friends of friends, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Rival at the Year Gate
sections.text: The Rival stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: you grew up in a bold family where money moved fast. People who knew your first home remember its nerve and its charm, the way it won over a crowded table. Because boldness was praised at home, people warm to you quickly, and you act while others are still deciding. You learned to spend as fast as you earn, much of it on friends, and you feel uneasy holding on to money for long.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate
sections.text: The Sage stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are seen as the calm one who knows things. The people above you at work take you seriously early, because you have the facts and a steady manner. Their trust moves your career through reputation and study more than through pushing, and you learn whatever they are willing to teach. Your friends come to you with their problems for the same reason. You give a great deal of calm away, and you are rarely the one anyone thinks to look after.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Twin inside the Day Gate
sections.text: The Twin lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: you love as an equal, and only as an equal. At home you want two people deciding and neither one in charge, and you lose patience with a partner who leans on you for every choice. Because equality is how you feel respected, you track who conceded the last argument, and you rarely say so. Your friendships run on the same level terms, and you keep the friends a partner also respects. You grow easier about being looked after once someone has proved they stand level with you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: in later life your standing and your standards are what people see. Your judgement is still wanted long after a job has ended, and the requests grow with each decade. Because doing things properly is how you earn your place, you take on roles of trust in later life and fill them with care. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, measure themselves against your example. In your circle and at home your name is one people rely on, and you keep it in good order.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your work is only as good as your sleep.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your body and your work move together, and both run best on regular meals, real rest and a steady routine. Because food and rest are pleasures to you, you eat late and sleep short in busy months, and your energy drops. You notice tiredness in your work before you feel it, and a few good nights put it right.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: Whenever you were tired or run down as a child, someone was there with a meal and an early night, and you were yourself again within days. By your teens you had a steady energy the adults around you counted on, and you have kept much of it since.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your energy has followed your routine closely since your late teens, high in the months you slept and ate well and flat when either slipped. At least once a long stretch of hard work wore you down, and you came back from it through rest more than effort.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Your sleep has deepened since your late forties and your appetite has steadied, and you have enjoyed your food more than ever. Your energy has dipped in the stretches when you were on your own too much, and it has come back each time the house filled up again.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1986 to 1995
sections.text: Rich food, late nights and easy evenings piled up in those years, and your energy dropped as the habits grew. A plain daily routine brought you back, and you felt the change within weeks.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2026 to 2035 · now
sections.text: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2026 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2029 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2032 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate
sections.text: The Sage lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your childhood was real care, steady enough to trust. Someone in your first home gave you decent, patient care, and the ease it gave you became the way you meet the world. Because care reached you early, you trust people first, and you find the protective ones quickly. The same safety made leaving it hard, and you have stayed in comfortable places longer than they helped you grow. You still sleep and eat better after a hard season once you are back with the people who love you.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Month Gate
sections.text: The Artisan holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years run on steady craft and a body kept well. You do your work quietly and without fuss, and over the years you produce more than people who make more noise. Because your energy comes from sleep, food and routine, your work rises and falls with how well you are living. You do your best in making, feeding or teaching, and you keep improving at it long after others have peaked.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Artisan lives inside your Hour Gate: your later life settles into good food, deep sleep and people who keep coming back. In later life you get to enjoy the comfort you have worked for, and your home fills with younger people and long friendships. Because care has always meant a good meal and a warm bed to you, you keep feeding whoever comes, whether they are children or younger relatives or someone you train. Ease is both the reward of those years and their one risk, and you stay well for as long as your days keep a rhythm.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your career runs on craft and good habits.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: Your best work comes from skill built slowly, in fields where the hands or the senses know things. Since steady practice is what you trust, you are slow to take on work you cannot yet do well, and you miss a few openings that way. You are seldom the loudest on a team, and your work is the work that holds up.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: You also find your mentors inside the structures you join, and your name gathers weight the slow and lasting way.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Older people at work have backed you since your late teens, vouched for you or quietly put your name forward. You have collected qualifications and references in those years that still carry weight wherever you apply, and you have needed to push less than most.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: You have built your skill quietly since your late teens, through practice more than ambition, in work that let you make or tend something. In time the people around you came to call your skill a gift, and you knew it had come one day at a time.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2016 to 2025

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2026 to 2035 · now

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your later family is the people at your table.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You treat anyone who eats at your home often enough as family, and a friend who comes every week matters to you as much as a cousin. Because feeding people is how you show care, you keep inviting people long after others have stopped hosting. Your house stays busy because of it, and you would feel lost in a home that no one visits.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · inside · lived
sections.text: A parent or an older relative looked after you closely when you were small, and you came to rely on their calm. By your teens you expected the world to treat you with the same care, and mostly it did.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Younger people in your family have watched how you conduct yourself since your late forties, and they copied more than you knew. More than once a word of your approval stayed with one of them for years, and you heard about it only later.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Your home has filled with the people after you since your late forties, and with friends who come for the food. You have hosted more in this stretch than in any earlier decade, and you have started to be fed by the people you once fed.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 1966 to 1975
sections.text: In those years you kept your own counsel at home and turned down help you were offered more than once. The distance grew quietly, and what carried you was the one relative who treated you as an equal.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1986 to 1995
sections.text: During those years you gave your family more comfort than they asked for, and some of them came to expect it. You spoiled the people closest to you, and you got your own ease back once others began to care for you in turn.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 2006 to 2015

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 2016 to 2025
sections.text: Meals, chores and repairs ran smoothly at home in those years because you saw to them. Your family grew used to your steadiness, and you took pride in it.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Magistrate decade · 2036 to 2045
sections.text: You hold a proper place in your family in these years, as the reliable one with a role and a duty. You earn a standing among your relatives that lasts well beyond the decade.

sections.text: An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.head: TITLE
sections.sub: Three seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Rising Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your savings grow quietly, year after year.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You save a part of everything you earn, and a steady rise in your accounts pleases you more than any windfall. Because security is what you are working for, you avoid risks that would make you rich quickly. Your caution keeps you safe, and you feel a good year as relief more than as joy.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Underneath, what you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play. In you the gap is short, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Even in lean months you have put money aside since your late teens, and your savings have grown more than people expected. You have turned down at least one exciting offer because it asked too much risk.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your best money moments so far came through someone else, a tip or a job offer or a deal brought to you by a friend. You lost money the same way, by saying yes before you had read the terms.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · inside · now
sections.text: Your finances have settled since your late forties, and your household has felt the hard times around it less than most. You have spent more on others than on your own comfort in that time.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1976 to 1985
sections.text: Expenses felt heavy in those years, and you counted money long after there was enough. Your savings grew while your pleasure shrank, and you came through on the security that careful habit built.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Horizon decade · 1986 to 1995
sections.text: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.

sections.sub: A Rival decade · 2036 to 2045
sections.text: Shared money works for you in these ten years, because the contest with others keeps you sharp. You do better with people at your side than alone, and you keep a fair part of what you win together.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)

sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

The cost is a tight grip, and you take less pleasure in what you have built than it could give you.

sections.text: The Horizon lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life always has an opening in it. You want a home life with somewhere to go in it, and you are drawn to people whose world is wider than yours. Because your openings come through the people closest to you, love and opportunity arrive together for you more often than for most. Your home years open wider than any before them, and you share them with a person whose world is bigger than your own.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)

sections.text: The Steward lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years sits a quiet habit of keeping everything provided for. In later life you want things settled, with savings kept, care arranged and nothing left to chance. Because providing is how you love, you make arrangements for others long before they are needed, and you keep your own sleep and meals in the same good order. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn thrift by watching you. Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.

sections.head: TITLE

sections.text: Your career grows slowly and keeps growing.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You do your best work in a job you can stay in and get better at, with clear tasks and fair pay. Because you value what you can explain and defend, you distrust shortcuts and the people who take them. You are underrated in the early years of any role, and you outlast most of the people who underrated you.

sections.head: HOW YOU ARE · the pair line
sections.text: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Bosses have either backed you fully or tried to slow you down since your late teens, and few have stayed neutral about you. You have done your best work for the ones who believed in you, and you have outlasted most of the ones who did not.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Steward inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · inside · lived
sections.text: Your working life has moved forward one step at a time since your late teens, with each job adding a skill you kept. More than once you have overtaken people who started faster than you.

sections.head: SEAT

sections.text: Your work has grown bolder since your late forties, and you have said things in public that you once kept back. At least once a role ended because you would not soften a view, and you did better work in the next one.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Artisan decade · 1966 to 1975
sections.text: Comfort dulled your drive at work in those years, and easy work held you longer than it should have. You were well liked and under-stretched, and the skill you kept practising for pleasure is what kept you going.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Steward decade · 1976 to 1985
sections.text: Safety kept you in one place too long during those years, and your duties grew faster than your reward. You carried the extra load reliably, and it earned you a trust that later work paid for.

sections.text: Rules and rank pressed on your work during those years, and you followed procedure long after it stopped helping. You were reliable to a fault, and your record carried you to better places later.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A General decade · 2006 to 2015
sections.text: Pressure in your work came without pause in those years, from hard demands, tight deadlines and fights you had not chosen. You kept going on sheer will, and the few people who stood by you carried you through.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 2026 to 2035 · now
sections.text: Unusual knowledge brings you work in these years, through research, advice or technical skill. People come to you for what others do not know, and your name grows inside a small field.

sections.text: Your family rests on what you quietly arrange.

sections.text: You look after your family through arrangements, the bills covered and the plans made for whoever needs them. sections.head: HOW YOU ARE
sections.text: You grow by doing familiar things better, holding the same values to a higher standard. Because consistency matters to you, you would rather redo a thing properly than try something new, and the change in you shows up as patience. You redo a job nobody else would have noticed was wrong, and you feel better for it.

sections.head: GAP ROW
sections.sub: Home Chapter · 35 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: Since your mid-thirties you have kept to what you already do well, and you have started fewer new things than in any years before.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2037 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Your learning goes on in public from your late forties, through new work and through friendships with people much younger than you. You grow more curious with each decade, and you are the one in your family with the newest stories.

sections.head: SEAT
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2037 · inside · coming
sections.text: Past your late forties you keep improving at what you already know, and each year adds polish more than novelty. You grow wiser through repetition and care, and you end up with a character that others hold up as an example.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: An Alchemist decade · 1990 to 1999
sections.text: Unconventional paths taught you most in those years, a strange course, a self-taught skill or a mentor outside the usual. You developed in your own direction, and the difference became your strength.

sections.head: BY DECADE (Advisor)
sections.sub: A Twin decade · 2010 to 2019
sections.text: Your progress in those years came from peers who were your equals, people you learned beside more than beneath. You set your own standard and met it, and the confidence lasted.

sections.head: BY YEAR (Advisor)
sections.sub: 2027 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Horizon at the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures. In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.

sections.head: SEAT CARD (context)
sections.sub: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate
sections.text: The Magistrate lives inside your Hour Gate: your later years rest on a quiet sense of duty done well. You want your affairs settled and your debts paid, and an unanswered letter stays on your mind until it is done. Because keeping your word is how you feel at peace, you finish what you owe before you allow yourself to rest. The ones who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, trust that your arrangements will hold. Your growth in later life comes from the few things you value, done a little better each year.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You keep growing through the few who match you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You grow in later life through two or three people who push you as hard as you push yourself. Because you learn only from someone you respect, you ignore advice from anyone who talks down to you. Your progress is slower without that small company, and you notice it within weeks.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your family learns independence by watching you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: In your family you manage alone and see more than you say, and your relatives know it. Because asking for help feels like losing ground, you keep your troubles to yourself until they are over. The younger people in your family admire you, and you are harder for them to reach than you know.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You do your best work as nobody's junior.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You work best when the task is yours from start to finish and your name is on it. Because your own effort is how you measure yourself, you resent shared credit more than hard work, and you slow down the moment a manager hovers. What you want from a job is a clean scoreboard and nobody holding the other end.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are the relative who never needs rescuing.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You do your part in the family before anyone thinks to ask, and you expect nothing back. Because your first home rewarded self-reliance, you call your relatives when there is something to offer, rarely when there is something to ask. Your relatives hear from you less than they want, and you mean the quiet as a kindness.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You rise fastest where the score is public.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You come alive in work that ranks people openly, commissions and targets and anything with a clear winner. Because you need proof that you are winning, a vague team goal leaves you flat and restless. You unsettle quieter colleagues without meaning to, and you do your best work where nobody minds.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your later money keeps moving, and so do you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You keep money in motion, in a late venture or a trip or help for someone younger with a plan. Because an untouched account feels wasted to you, you spend on movement and company before you think of reserves. Your savings grow slowly because so much of your money is always on its way somewhere.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are paid for spotting the chance others miss.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You do your best work wherever there is something to find, a client or a deal or a gap in the market. Because the search keeps you sharp, a fixed salary and a quiet desk wear you down faster than hard work. You are the colleague people come to first when they need a way in.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your family taught you generosity, and its price.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You give freely in your family, the treat paid for and the loan made without terms. Because an older relative showed you that generosity makes people love you, you find it hard to refuse anyone close. You keep giving after you can afford to, and you resent it only later.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You grow in later life by keeping only what matters.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Interests and habits that no longer teach you anything fall away, and you hold on hard to the few that do. Because you grow by going deeper more than wider, you look as if you are doing less while you understand more. You care less each year about keeping up, and more about getting one thing right.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your later work is advice, and people pay for it.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: In later life you move toward advisory work, the expert called in when the usual answers run out. Because people value what you alone can see, your name opens doors without a title attached, and you prefer it that way. You turn down steady roles and say yes to hard problems.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are hired for the problems nobody else can solve.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Colleagues come to you when a problem has stopped making sense. Because your value lies in seeing what others miss, you choose a narrow speciality over a broad ladder, and you lose interest in work anyone could do. Your reputation travels further than your title, and it travels slowly.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your authority keeps growing while others step back.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You stay in demand late, the one called when a problem is too hard for anyone else. Because pressure is where you feel useful, you take on serious responsibility at an age when most people are easing off. What you find hardest is a calendar with nothing urgent in it, and you fill it fast.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your family measures itself against your standards.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You hold the people in your family to high standards, and you notice the slip before the effort. Because demands are how you show care, the people close to you feel the weight before they feel the care. Your family respects you deeply, and some of them wait a long time for your praise.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your career rises fastest where the stakes are highest.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are given the urgent problem, the team in trouble or the deadline that cannot slip. Because you stay steady when others panic, your managers trust you with more than your title says, and the load keeps growing. You earn rank through pressure, and you rarely get a quiet week.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Authority found you early and kept finding you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You end up in charge in most places you work, often before you ask for it. Because pressure has been familiar since your first years, you take on serious work that makes others nervous. You rise through hard roles, and you find easy ones dull within months.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your best work is the work you do last.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You do your best work where you can say what you think, and a job that asks for quiet manners tires you. Because your skill has grown faster than your patience for rules, you are better at the job than many who manage it. What you make in later life outlasts the job that paid for it, and you judge yourself by the work alone.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are hired for your talent and tested on your discipline.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You do your strongest work where you can be seen doing it, pitching or teaching or leading from the front. Because you need honest credit to stay interested, a desk job under close supervision drains you within months. Your talent wins you the role, and your record of finishing decides how long you keep it.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You become the relative everyone wants to visit.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: In your family you are the one who remembers birthdays, cooks for the holidays and never arrives empty-handed. Because giving is how you feel close, you hand over gifts more easily than advice. Your family takes after your kindness more than your opinions, and you are glad of the trade.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your later work is your most generous.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You work best on things that feed people in some way, a meal or a lesson or a well-made thing. Because making something well gives you more pleasure than any title, you turn down promotions that would take you away from the work itself. Your work runs on pleasure, and you do more of it in a happy month than in a pressured year.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You earn most from the work you enjoy.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your best work comes when you like it, and everyone around you can tell the difference within a week. Since pleasure is what keeps you going, a joyless job empties you out faster than a demanding one. Your ease makes you look less ambitious than you are, and you let the finished work speak for you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You end up as the one who provides.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You show love for the people who rely on you by making sure they are covered. Because provision is how you say what matters, you are more comfortable paying for something than talking about it. You want everyone who comes after you to be safe, and you plan for it years early.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are the one trusted with the books.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are given charge of money and order wherever you work, and things run better near your desk. Because reliability is what you offer, you accept extra tasks without asking for more pay or a promotion. You carry more of the work than your title shows, and your colleagues lean on it.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You were raised in a careful, orderly home.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You show love in your family by keeping things in order, the bills paid and the arrangements made. Because care at home looked like provision when you were small, you trust a relative who plans more than one who says warm things. You are the one your family calls when something needs organising, and you rarely say no.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your family takes its standards from you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You set a clear example for your family, and you notice when someone falls short of it. Because you care about doing things properly, you correct before you praise, and the people close to you remember both. Your approval matters more to them than you realise, and you give it less than they need.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your later working life moves toward leadership.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You are drawn in later life to work that keeps an organisation sound, the overseeing and the guiding more than the doing. Because you respect structure, you would rather look after something lasting than start something new. Your value at work now lies in judgement, and you are trusted with decisions others will not make.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Your record earns you rank.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You climb at work through trust, the clean record and the job done the way it should be. Because being correct matters to you, you follow the rules others bend, and senior people notice. You rise steadily, and you find it hard to take a risk that could mark your record.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: People trust you before they know you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: New people give you their trust quickly, and you are offered responsibility in a group before you have earned it. Because a good name was part of your upbringing, you behave in public with care, and you dislike being seen at your worst. Your standing is a real advantage, and you guard it more closely than you need to.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You come from a family that kept its standards.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You hold your family's name with pride and some strain, and its standards still shape what you allow yourself. Because what the family stood for was visible to others, you feel its expectations most in public. You honour the values you were given, and you quietly drop the rules that never made sense.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You become the one your family turns to.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: When your family needs advice or a calm word in a bad week, you are the one they call. Because protecting the young matters to you deeply, you step in early when someone younger is struggling, and you give more than you are asked for. You are respected at family gatherings more than you are relaxed at them.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You grow in later life by teaching.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: Passing on what you know is how you grow now, through lessons, letters or the patient answer to a question. Because teaching makes you put your knowledge in order, you understand your own life better each time you explain it. You find a new purpose in being useful to people who are just starting.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You rise at work because people trust you.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You win roles through references, qualifications and the good word of people senior to you. Because steadiness is what you offer, you are given responsibility early, and you rarely have to sell yourself. You find open competition uncomfortable and do your best work where trust is already in place.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: You grew up protected by someone principled.

sections.head: UNIT
sections.text: The steady, decent care you had early is the measure you hold family to, and you notice quickly when it is missing. Because your first home gave you safety and clear values, you trust family as the place to turn first. You judge a relative by whether they keep their word, and you say so when they do not.
